A warning delivered thirteen minutes before expiry is not a warning, the run says so, and the 12:22 and 13:21 rows had both named this slot in advance - so a duty was carried across three runs and discharged by the one that could still make it useful. IT ALSO CORRECTED ITS OWN PREDECESSOR'S EMPHASIS RATHER THAN INHERITING IT: the 13:21 run reported the drift ACCELERATING at 0.35 in an hour, and this run reported that the next hour added 0.03, which changes the story without moving the level any closer. Correcting a previous hour's framing while the previous hour's conclusion still stands is a distinction most logs collapse.

entries.head: No exit is due against a flat book, and the AS specification is re-quoted and CONFIRMED for a sixth and final hour - valid, untriggered, and needing a 2.20% collapse in six minutes, which is recorded as out of reach rather than as live
entries.body:
CONFIRM, FOR THE SIXTH AND LAST TIME, WITH SIX MINUTES ON THE CLOCK. AS is 34.63 bid / 34.65 ask at 19:22:47.858Z on a 0.058% spread, last trade 34.645, +3.00% on the bid against the 33.62 settled close. The 33.87 limit is unfilled and sits 0.76 below the bid. The specification stands as written and THE LIMIT IS NOT RAISED, for a tenth and final time.

THE BOOK IS FLAT AND NO EXIT IS DUE. Equity positions and option positions were both queried live at 15:22 against the mandate account and both lists are empty. There is no target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window to reach. Zero equity orders and zero option orders exist with a created_at floor of today, so the 33.87 level remains unowned at the last hourly that could have owned it. Balance 1009.16, all cash, zero unsettled.

THE THREE-LIMB KILL TEST, RUN A FOURTH TIME AND ANSWERED THE SAME WAY. Limb one, the written invalidation: untriggered and never close. The early warning is a trade below 33.70 - that is the session low EXACTLY, set in the opening thirty-minute bar and unrevisited in the nine and a half hours since - and the outright void is a close below 33.41, which finishes the day 1.22 below the bid having never been testable. Limb two, the limit no longer inside the spread: met on a literal reading and rejected on the narrow one the 10:21 run wrote down and every hourly since has defended, that a buy limit the tape has risen ABOVE is a resting bid rather than a dead level. This morning proved that reading by filling-distance, when AS came back through 33.87 and traded there for forty minutes while the specification was live. Limb three, whether the setup described is still the setup on the tape: it is more true than when it was written. The setup was a day-2 post-earnings continuation off a 100% EPS beat entered on a pullback, with a higher low at 33.70 as its written support. 33.70 held all session as the exact low and the name set a fresh 34.83 session high in the 14:00 ET bar.

SO WHAT LEFT THE TAPE IS THE ENTRY PRICE, NOT THE SETUP, AND THOSE ARE DIFFERENT OBJECTS. Killing this specification in its last six minutes because the thesis worked without the board owning it is the exact mirror of raising the limit because the thesis worked without the board owning it. Both are the tape rewriting a level struck in advance, and a kill here would have changed no outcome while setting the precedent that a level struck in advance gets withdrawn once it looks bad. It is confirmed and it is left exactly where it was struck.

AND THE CONFIRMATION IS NOT A RECOMMENDATION, WHICH THIS RUN SAYS PLAINLY BECAUSE THE OPERATOR IS RELYING ON THE ROW. Filling at 33.87 requires a 2.20% collapse in six minutes, in a name that has printed session highs all afternoon. The lowest five-minute low between 14:20 and 15:20 ET is 34.32, a full 0.45 above the limit, so a resting order was unfillable for a FOURTH consecutive hour. The correct reading of this entry is: valid, untriggered, and out of reach - not actionable, and about to expire on its own terms at 15:30.

THE DRIFT DECELERATED FOR A SECOND HOUR AND IT BOUGHT NOTHING. The gap series across six reads is 0.26, 0.28, 0.36, 0.71, 0.74, 0.76: this hour added 0.02 after last hour added 0.03 and the 13:21 hour added 0.35. The 13:21 run's acceleration headline was corrected at 14:21 and stays corrected, but the correction only ever concerned the RATE. The LEVEL is the widest it has been at every single read including this one, which is the fact that decided the outcome.

THE UNCOMFORTABLE HALF, RECORDED AT ITS FULL SIZE BECAUSE THIS IS THE LAST HOUR IN WHICH IT IS STILL A LIVE QUESTION RATHER THAN A RETRO ONE. This is the fifth consecutive published specification nobody executed, after SMCI on 8/13, UPST on 8/14, SMCI on 8/17 and AS on 8/18. It is the FIRST of those whose level actually printed while the specification was live and re-validated, and it is the first not-forced six-of-six entry to die this way. The board found the setup its own rulebook names first, struck it on the pullback rather than the high, published it at 09:49, and re-quoted it six times across five and a half hours without once moving the level. Filled at 33.87 the 372.57 would read 380.93 now, up 8.36 or 2.24%. The 8.36 is not the point and never was. The point is that the 2026-08-18 rule change widened the execution window from forty minutes to five and a half hours precisely so that an entry would stop dying of not being seen, and this entry was seen, notified on, and still died - which means the remaining gap is not the window and not the notification. It is that nobody was at the desk to press the button in the forty minutes when the number was there. That is the finding this session hands the retro, and it is a more useful one than another hour of re-validation would have been.

NO NOTIFICATION FROM THIS RUN, AND THE REASONING IS WRITTEN DOWN RATHER THAN LEFT AS SILENCE. The step-5 last-hour trigger was discharged by the 14:21 run at sixty-seven minutes out, which is the point in the hour at which that warning can still be acted on, and the 12:22 and 13:21 rows both named that slot as the one that owed it. Firing it again at six minutes would deliver an operator a ping about an order that cannot fill, on a day this slot has already pinged once. The rulebook's own stated cost of the unnecessary notification is that it teaches an operator to ignore the necessary one.
entries.grade: PASS ON THE DECISION, WITH A FLAG ON THE VOCABULARY RATHER THAN ON THE RUN. Re-quoted inside its hour for a sixth and final time, limit not raised for a tenth time against a name printing session highs all afternoon, both written invalidations re-checked and both untouched at expiry - 33.70 was the session low EXACTLY and unrevisited, 33.41 was 1.22 away and never testable. The run's key judgement is right and is stated in the strongest available form: filling this specification required a 2.20% collapse in six minutes, that is not a live proposition, and THE OPERATOR SHOULD NOT READ THIS CONFIRMATION AS ONE. Recording a specification as out of reach rather than as live, in the same breath as confirming it, is the opposite of the failure this slot could have committed. The decision not to re-ping is correct and reasoned - the last-hour trigger was discharged at 14:21 and a second ping would tell the operator that something needing a 2.20% collapse in six minutes has six minutes left. THE FLAG IS NOT AGAINST THIS RUN. Four of today's six confirms describe a specification that was valid, untriggered and unreachable, and each run had to spend a paragraph building that state because confirm-or-kill does not contain it. Six rows reading CONFIRMED can be misread later as six live hours when four and a half of them were not. A distinct 'confirmed - out of reach' state is a rulebook change and is recommended to the operator in the ledger, not adopted here.

entries.head: The AS specification expired at 15:30 unexecuted, 0.57 under the bid - the fifth in a row to die that way and the first whose level actually printed while it was live. The book is flat, so nothing is held overnight and no exit is due
entries.body:
THIS ENTRY EXISTS TO CLOSE A SPECIFICATION, NOT TO OPEN ANYTHING. The 09:49 will entry of today - buy 11 shares of AS at a 33.87 limit, not forced, six of six on the checklist - reached its 15:30 ET expiry with no order behind it. That will entry is untouched and stays untouched: why.json is append-only and the record of what was decided in the morning is not editable by the afternoon that watched it fail.

THE NUMBER NEXT TO THE LIMIT, WHICH IS THE POINT OF WRITING THIS DOWN. AS is 34.44 bid / 34.47 ask at 19:36:06.692Z on a 0.087% spread, last trade 34.46, +2.44% on the bid against the 33.62 settled close. The limit was 33.87. The final five-minute bar before expiry, 15:25 to 15:30 ET, opened 34.63, ranged 34.47 to 34.63 and closed 34.53 on 32,813 shares - so the specification died 0.60 below the lowest tick of the bar it died in, and sits 0.57 below the bid six minutes later. This is the bid at the run rather than the official settled close, which is twenty-four minutes away and which no run inside this window can honestly quote.

WHAT WOULD HAVE HAPPENED IS RECORDED BECAUSE THE COMFORTABLE VERSION AND THE UNCOMFORTABLE VERSION ARE BOTH TRUE. Filled at 33.87 the 372.57 would read 378.84 on this bid, up 6.27 or 1.68%. The thesis was right and the board owns nothing.

BOTH WRITTEN INVALIDATIONS DIED UNTRIGGERED, WHICH MAKES THIS A DIFFERENT FAILURE FROM BEING WRONG. The early warning was a trade below 33.70; 33.70 is the session low EXACTLY, set in the opening thirty-minute bar and never revisited in a full session of tape. The outright void was a close below 33.41, which finishes more than a dollar below the bid having never once been testable. The setup the entry described - a day-2 post-earnings continuation off a 100% EPS beat, entered on the pullback, with a higher low at 33.70 as its written support - ends the day MORE confirmed than when it was written, with that low holding all session and a 34.83 session high in the 14:00 bar. What left the tape was the entry price, not the setup.

IT IS NOT RE-STRUCK FOR TOMORROW, AND THAT REFUSAL IS THE SAME ONE THIS BOARD MADE TEN TIMES TODAY SEEN FROM THE OTHER END. Carrying 33.87 overnight would be a standing instruction resting on a tape that no longer exists; re-striking it higher to meet a 34.44 bid would be the limit chasing the name, which the 2026-08-18 rule change forbids in the same breath that it widened the window. Tomorrow's open writes tomorrow's entry on tomorrow's quotes or it writes nothing.

THE FIFTH CONSECUTIVE UNEXECUTED SPECIFICATION, AND THE ONE THAT NARROWS THE DIAGNOSIS. SMCI 8/13, UPST 8/14, SMCI 8/17, AS 8/18 and now AS 8/19. The 2026-08-18 change was written against exactly this pattern and it did its job on every axis it could: the window went from forty minutes to five and a half hours, the level was re-quoted and confirmed at 10:21, 11:22, 12:22, 13:21, 14:21 and 15:21 without ever being moved, and the operator was notified at 14:21 with sixty-seven minutes left. The level traded for roughly forty minutes this morning across seven five-minute bars. Every process control fired and the entry still died, so the residual failure is not the window, not the re-validation and not the notification - it is that no order was resting during the only forty minutes it could have filled. A published specification requiring a human at a desk is a specification that grades the desk. That is what this session hands the retro.

NO OVERNIGHT HOLD IS DECIDED BECAUSE THERE IS NOTHING TO HOLD, AND FLAT IS WRITTEN DOWN AS A DECISION RATHER THAN LEFT AS AN ABSENCE. Equity and option position lists were BOTH queried live at 15:36 against the mandate account and BOTH ARE EMPTY, and zero equity orders and zero option orders exist with a created_at floor of today. So no target, no stop and no time stop can be enforced tonight, and NO OPTION NO-FLY WINDOW EXISTS - not as a judgement about any earnings date, but because no contract is held for a print to land in front of. Going into a calendar where NVDA reports on 8/26, flat is usually the right position and it is the one this board holds by arithmetic rather than by nerve.

NO NEW ENTRY, AND THE REASON IS STRUCTURAL. The daily entry mandate binds the open slot by its own text and was discharged at 09:49. This slot is forbidden from opening a position in the last thirty minutes, and the temptation it exists to refuse is precisely today's: a thesis that was right, a price that ran away, and twenty-four minutes in which chasing 34.44 could be dressed up as conviction. Buying AS here would be the identical trade this run just refused to re-strike, with the rule filed off.
entries.grade: PASS ON THE DECISION, WITH A FLAG ON A PUBLISHED NUMBER FOR THE NINTH CONSECUTIVE SESSION. On the decision: all four step-2 questions were asked and each is answered from live evidence rather than assumed, both position lists were queried live at 15:36, the flat book is recorded as a DECISION rather than a leftover, and THE DEATH CERTIFICATE WAS WRITTEN BY APPENDING A NEW did ENTRY RATHER THAN BY TOUCHING THE 09:49 will, which is the invariant this file rests on. The refusal to re-strike 33.87 for tomorrow is right and is given the right reason - a specification carried overnight is a standing instruction resting on a tape that no longer exists. moves.json was pruned against a live calendar re-pull with the carried spot refreshed from a live quote rather than left to rot, both duties recorded as performed. The silence is correct: none of its four triggers fired. AND THE RUN FOUND THE DAY'S SHARPEST QUESTION ITSELF - that the window was widened, the entry was published at 09:49, re-quoted six times, notified on with sixty-seven minutes to run, and still died, so the remaining gap is neither the window nor the notification. THE FLAG: this entry prices the miss at +6.27 or +1.68% off a 34.44 BID timestamped 19:36:06.692Z, and state.json carries the same figure. AS printed 34.01 at 15:59:56 ET, which makes the miss 1.54 or 0.41% - the published figure overstates it by more than fourfold, because AS gave back 0.52 in the closing half hour, entirely after the specification was already dead. The number was pulled live and labelled a bid at a stated timestamp, so it is not an invented figure and the grade is unchanged; the run fired twenty-four minutes before the bell and could not have known. But this is the ninth consecutive session on which a pre-bell bid has stood in for a close in a published figure, and tonight the error runs the same way it did on 8/18 - toward making the board's undelivered specification look more costly than it was. THE RUN'S OWN OPEN CAUGHT THIS EXACT SUBSTITUTION THIS MORNING, in yesterday's pre-close, before acting on it. Nine hours later the same slot committed it again. A correction applied to yesterday's number but not adopted as practice is how a nine-session pattern reaches nine sessions.

entries.head: Day-2 continuation in TGT at 159.36 for 2 shares, five of six and not forced - the name this board named in advance yesterday, bought on the reclaim rather than the high, with its options refused on a 22% spread

order.timeStop: 5 sessions - the 8/26 close, counting 8/20 as session 1

entries.body:
THE ENTRY. Buy 2 shares of TGT at a 159.36 limit, 318.72 or 31.6% of a 1009.16 account, target 191.23, stop 146.61, time stop the 8/26 close counting today as session 1. Not forced: items 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6 pass and item 3 is not applicable. The quotes behind this limit were pulled at 09:47 ET - 158.82 bid / 159.36 ask, last 159.095, a 0.339% spread - and specStruckAt records that, because under the 15:30 window a fill at 14:00 is not the entry this reasoning describes and the grader needs the gap.

THIS IS THE FIRST ENTRY THIS BOARD HAS WRITTEN AGAINST A TEST IT SET FOR ITSELF IN ADVANCE, AND THAT IS THE MAIN REASON IT IS WORTH GRADING. Yesterday's open ranked TGT second and REFUSED it at 160.45 on item 2 - buying 9.7% off a session low fourteen minutes old, at a fresh 52-week high, on day 1 - and then wrote down, before knowing anything about today, exactly what would make it a buy: a day-2 hold above the close on lighter volume, with an entry struck after the fade rather than at the high. The board also said why it was writing it down: so that today's run would not be free to discover it conveniently. So the test gets graded honestly, limb by limb, and it comes to TWO OF THREE rather than three of three.

LIMB ONE, LIGHTER VOLUME: MET, and not narrowly. TGT has done 672,800 shares in the first fifteen minutes against 2.16M in yesterday's first thirteen, on a 3.95M thirty-day average and a 4.80M two-week average. Yesterday's full session was 9.47M, roughly 2.4x normal. Today is pacing at a fraction of that.

LIMB TWO, THE ENTRY AFTER THE FADE RATHER THAN AT THE HIGH: MET. The 159.36 limit is 1.06 below today's 160.42 session high and 2.62 below yesterday's 161.9799, which the fundamentals pull confirms is the 52-week high, set 2026-08-19. It is also 1.09 BELOW the 160.45 this board declined yesterday, so this is not the same trade at a worse price - it is a cheaper entry into a setup that has since acquired the one thing it was missing, which is a second session.

LIMB THREE, THE HOLD ABOVE THE CLOSE: BROKEN AND THEN RECLAIMED, WHICH IS NOT THE SAME AS HELD, AND THIS ENTRY WILL NOT PRETEND OTHERWISE. TGT opened 155.8554, well under the 159.00 settled close, and traded down to 154.58 in the opening five-minute bar - 2.78% below the close. It then ran to 160.42 in the second bar and is 158.82 bid / 159.36 ask now, essentially back on the close. A run reading this at 13:00 should know that the clean version of yesterday's condition did NOT occur. What occurred is a shakeout and a reclaim, which is a defensible day-2 structure and arguably a better one - the weak holders from a 9.7% reversal day were flushed in the first five minutes and the stock recovered the level anyway - but it is a different fact from the one the test asked for, and the difference is the sort of thing a board grades itself generously on if it does not write it down first.

ITEM 1, THE CATALYST, IS THE STRONGEST ON THE BOARD AND IS ONE SESSION OLD. TGT reported 8/19 before the open at 2.46 EPS against a 2.25 estimate, a 9.3% beat, verified on the live calendar. The price action around it is the part that matters: the stock opened 147.80, BELOW the 152.48 prior close, bottomed at 146.21, and closed 159.00 - a 52-week high - on 9.47M shares. That is a 8.74% low-to-close reversal on 2.4x volume. A gap down that is bought all day and closes at a new high is a re-rating, not a drift, and it is the kind of single-session structure that tends to have a second day.

ITEM 5 PASSES ON EVIDENCE FROM TODAY'S OWN TAPE, AND THE TAPE IS UNUSUALLY GENEROUS ABOUT IT. Item 5 says crowded bulls and raised targets into a print mean a merely-good report sells off. TGT went into this print DE-RISKED, which is the opposite condition: it fell 155.51, 154.48, 151.01, 152.48 across the four sessions before the report, and then gapped DOWN on the print itself before reversing. Nobody was crowded long. The live control group is this morning and it is brutal: WMT beat at 0.81 against 0.74 and is 104.48 bid, -8.59%. AAP beat at 1.03 against 0.81, a 27% beat, and is 44.55 bid, -20.70%. BILL beat at 0.84 against 0.62, a 35% beat, and is -0.57%. ATHM beat at 0.36 against 0.27 and is -2.22%. TJX beat yesterday and is -2.40% today on top of -1.4%. Five beats being sold or ignored on the same tape on which TGT, one session off its own beat, is holding a 52-week-high close. That is the item-5 mechanism firing on five names and not on this one, which is a far better argument than any assertion about positioning.

ITEM 3 IS NOT APPLICABLE AND IT IS EVIDENCED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. The rulebook requires the ATM straddle before any earnings-adjacent hold. There is no earnings-adjacent hold here: a live calendar pull for 2026-08-19 through 2026-08-26 returns TGT exactly once, on 8/19, the print this entry is trading the day after. The 8/26 time stop lands before anything TGT-specific, so no straddle is owed and none is invented. NVDA on 8/26 after the close is the only dated event inside the window at all and TGT is not in that complex.

ITEM 4, LIQUIDITY, IS THE BEST THIS BOARD HAS EVER SPECIFIED AGAINST. Market cap 72.2B. Thirty-day average volume 3.95M shares, two-week 4.80M. 672,800 shares in the first fifteen minutes of today. The spread is 0.54 on a 159.36 offer, 0.339%. For comparison the AS entries were struck at 0.148% on a 19.71B name, and the SMR contract this board once refused quoted 14.7%. Nothing here is thin.

THE OPTIONS WERE CHECKED FIRST, AS THE 2026-08-05 SIZE FINDING REQUIRES, AND THEY ARE REFUSED ON SPREAD FOR A SIXTH CONSECUTIVE SESSION. The rulebook says check affordability and spread BEFORE building a thesis around a contract, so the chain was pulled before the equity limit was struck. TGT lists 2026-09-18, 30 days out and inside the 3-6 week window, with no TGT print before it. Three strikes were quoted at 13:44:43Z. The 155 call, contract baec50ff-651b-4b66-b1e0-c4cbc1b2fc27: 7.00 bid / 8.75 ask on a 7.875 mark - a 22.2% spread against a 10% ceiling - with delta 0.668 and 3,747 open interest. The 160 call: 4.30 / 5.95 on a 5.125 mark, 32.2%, delta 0.515, 1,756 open interest. The 165 call: 2.63 / 3.90 on a 3.265 mark, 38.9%, and delta 0.372 which is below the 0.40 floor as well. EVERY ONE FAILS ON SPREAD BY AT LEAST DOUBLE. The 160 call fails twice over: at a 5.125 mark one contract is 512.50, which is 50.8% of the account against the 40% single-name ceiling. The affordability half of the 2026-08-05 finding was answered by the funding on 8/10; the spread half has now refused options on six consecutive sessions and no balance narrows a spread. Equity on the same name at the same minute quoted 0.339%, which is 65 times tighter than the best of the three contracts.

WHAT IS GIVEN UP BY REFUSING THEM, PRICED HONESTLY. At delta 0.668 the 155 call reaches a +20% premium gain on roughly a 1.6% move in TGT, about 161.9 - inside yesterday's range and barely above today's high. The equity's +20% target of 191.23 requires a 20% move in five sessions in a 72.2B retailer, which is not a live proposition and is not being claimed as one. THAT ASYMMETRY IS REAL AND IT MATTERS TO HOW THIS ENTRY SHOULD BE READ: the honest expectation for the equity leg is that the TIME STOP or a written invalidation closes this position, not the target. The target is the rulebook's mechanical +20% and it is recorded because the rulebook requires a number, not because a 191.23 print is being forecast. What buys back that giveaway is the spread: a 22.2% round trip on the option means the position starts roughly 11% underwater on the mark before the stock moves at all, and a -40% option stop corresponds to about a 6% move in TGT, which a name that ranged 3.7% today can deliver on noise.

WHAT WOULD INVALIDATE THIS, WRITTEN BEFORE THE OUTCOME AND CHECKABLE BY A RUN THAT WAS NOT HERE AT 09:47. Two levels, in order. THE EARLY WARNING: a trade below 154.58, today's opening-bar low. That is the floor of the shakeout this entry is built on; if it goes, the reclaim failed on the day it was bought and the day-2 structure is gone. THE OUTRIGHT VOID: a close below 152.48, the 8/18 pre-print close. A close back under the level the stock traded at BEFORE the report means the entire re-rating has been given back and the thesis is not weakened but wrong, and the position comes off without waiting for the 146.61 stop. NOTE THE STRUCTURE DELIBERATELY: both invalidations sit ABOVE the mechanical stop, so the thesis is built to break before the stop does. An hourly run re-reading this at 13:00 needs only the tape and these three numbers - 154.58, 152.48, 146.61 - plus the 159.36 limit.

A COINCIDENCE WORTH NAMING BEFORE A GRADER FINDS IT: the -8% mechanical stop lands at 146.61, and yesterday's print-day low was 146.21. The stop is 0.40 above the exact low of the earnings session. That is arithmetic rather than design - 159.36 x 0.92 is what it is - but it means the mechanical stop sits at a level the stock has already tested and violently rejected once, which is a better place for it than most and is recorded so it is not later claimed as skill.

RANKED AGAINST THE ALTERNATIVES. SECOND, SQM: a 2.31 against 2.04 beat on 8/19, a 13% beat, 76.53 bid at 13:47 and +1.53%, showing the SAME gap-down-and-reclaim shape as TGT - it opened 74.18 below the 75.38 close and has run to 76.27. Item 2 actually passes MORE cleanly than on TGT, because SQM's day 1 paid only +1.2% and there is nothing to give back. It loses on item 4 and the margin is not close: 51,087 shares in fifteen minutes against TGT's 672,800, a 896,905 thirty-day average against 3.95M, and a 0.52% spread against 0.339%. It also loses on the thing that makes it attractive - a continuation needs day-1 strength to continue, and +1.2% is not much strength. THIRD, DE: beat 5.10 against 4.72 this morning and +3.33%, the best-behaved fresh print on the tape, REFUSED MECHANICALLY because one share is 599.98 or 59.5% of the account against a 40% ceiling, so there is no size at which it can be owned. FOURTH, NDSN: +2.02% on a 5% beat, affordable at 31.3% for one share, passed over because a modest print with a modest reaction is not this setup. REFUSED ON ITEM 2 OUTRIGHT: SCSC at +24.14%, which is the +8% day by a factor of three and carries a 1.79% spread besides. REFUSED AS BEATS THE TAPE SOLD OR IGNORED: WMT -8.59%, AAP -20.70%, BILL -0.57%, ATHM -2.22%, TJX -2.40%, VIK -0.18%, FLNG -0.03%, KEYS and JKHY now flat two sessions after their prints. REFUSED AS MISSES: BABA -3.62% on the largest miss of the day, NTES -4.62%, ZIM -1.61%, BIDU bouncing off an 8.66% drop - buying the down half of a print is not a setup here. LOW is TGT's direct comparable, beat by two cents which is not a catalyst, and is -2.73%; it is recorded next to this entry rather than omitted, because the honest reading is that the sector is not carrying TGT and TGT is carrying itself.

AS IS DEAD AND THIS IS THE HARDEST PARAGRAPH IN THE ENTRY TO WRITE. This board specified AS on 8/18 and again on 8/19, re-validated the second spec six times without ever raising the limit, and watched it expire unexecuted 0.57 under the bid. Today AS is 33.25 bid - 0.62 BELOW the 33.87 limit that never filled. The name it chased for two sessions is finally cheaper than the price it asked for. IT IS NOT REVIVED, because the 8/19 entry named a trade below 33.70 as the early warning that the day-2 structure had failed, and 33.25 is 0.45 through it. The higher low the entire thesis rested on is gone. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away; the mirror of that rule, which this board has not had to state until today, is that a dead level may not be revived because the name came back to it AFTER the structure broke. A cheaper entry into a setup that no longer exists is not a better entry. The same logic keeps SMCI dead at +3.91% and 0.23 from its own expired limit on a twentieth test.

SIZE AND MECHANICS. 2 shares is the largest quantity that fits under the 40% single-name ceiling: 2 x 159.36 = 318.72 = 31.6% of a 1009.16 account, where 3 shares would be 478.08 = 47.4% and fail the gate outright. This is a smaller position than the board has recently run - the AS entries were 36.9% - and the reason is price per share rather than conviction, which is worth stating because a 31.6% position that returns the mechanical +20% adds 6.3% to the account and the operator's stated objective is 10% a day. The rulebook's own section 5 already records that this arithmetic does not close, and the ordering when they conflict was decided in advance: the rulebook wins and the retro records the shortfall. Cash account, T+1, 1009.16 settled with ZERO unsettled, so there is no good-faith exposure and nothing is being bought with unsettled proceeds. The limit is struck AT the 159.36 ask, deliberately and for the same reason the last two entries were: five consecutive specifications have expired unexecuted, the 8/18 one missed by six cents, the 8/19 one printed its level on seven five-minute bars with nobody at the desk, and a limit resting at the bid is how that keeps happening. This is the third consecutive not-forced entry. The delivery leg - notifying the operator on this same pass rather than leaving it to an hourly to repair - is the part of this run the 8/19 retro graded as failed at the publishing pass, and it is being done here.

entries.head: The 159.36 TGT specification is re-quoted and CONFIRMED with five hours to run - the offer has come back 0.17 BELOW the limit so it is marketable at a better price than it was struck at, both written invalidations are untouched, and the level is neither raised nor lowered
entries.body:
THE ONE LIVE SPECIFICATION IS RE-QUOTED AND CONFIRMED, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THIS BOARD'S RECORD A RE-VALIDATION FINDS THE LIMIT MARKETABLE. The 09:47 entry - buy 2 shares of TGT at a 159.36 limit, target 191.23, stop 146.61, time stop the 8/26 close, expiring 15:30 ET today - was re-checked against live quotes at 14:24:53.879Z. TGT is 158.90 bid / 159.19 ask, last trade 159.04, a 0.29 spread or 0.182% of mark, against the 159.00 official settled close. THE LIMIT SITS 0.17 ABOVE THE OFFER. An order entered now does not rest and does not wait for a pullback: it fills immediately at 159.19 or better, for 318.38 against the 318.72 the entry was sized at, which is 31.5% of a 1009.16 account and inside the 40% single-name ceiling. The operator is not being asked to pay 159.36 - a limit order fills at the offer, and the offer is lower.

THE TAPE IS BACK EXACTLY WHERE THE ENTRY WAS REASONED, WHICH IS A STRONGER FINDING THAN THE LIMIT SIMPLY BEING REACHABLE. The 09:47 strike rested on a 158.82 bid / 159.36 ask. Thirty-seven minutes later the market is 158.90 / 159.19 - eight cents higher on the bid, seventeen lower on the offer. In between TGT ran to a 161.28 session high in the 09:50 five-minute bar, 1.92 above the limit, and faded the entire move back. So this is not a specification whose level the tape has abandoned and not one chasing a name that ran; it is a specification quoting the market it was written on, after a round trip that resolved nowhere.

BOTH WRITTEN INVALIDATIONS ARE UNTOUCHED, CHECKED AGAINST BARS RATHER THAN ASSERTED. The early warning is a trade below 154.58, today's opening-bar low and the floor of the shakeout the whole day-2 structure rests on. That number IS the low of the 09:30 bar, and nothing has traded below it since: across the nine subsequent five-minute bars the lowest low is 157.68, set in the 09:40 bar, and the current bid is 4.32 or 2.72% above the warning. The outright void is a close below 152.48, the 8/18 pre-print close, 6.42 below the bid and not testable until the bell. The 146.61 mechanical stop is 12.29 away and in any case unreachable on a position that does not exist. Nothing the entry named as a way for it to be wrong has happened.

THE KILL TEST IS APPLIED IN FULL AND LIMB TWO IS MET IN THE DOWNWARD DIRECTION - THE DIRECTION YESTERDAY'S RUN NAMED AS THE ONE WORTH KILLING - SO THIS IS DECIDED IN WRITING AND NOT WAVED THROUGH. A specification dies when its stated invalidation triggers, when its limit is no longer inside the spread, or when the setup it described is no longer the setup on the tape. Limbs one and three fail plainly on the evidence above. Limb two is met word-for-word: 159.36 is not inside a 158.90/159.19 market. And it is met DOWNWARD, where the 8/19 10:21 run drew its distinction and wrote that the downward departure is the case worth killing, because the order 'would buy above the offer, into a decline, and the level it was reasoned on is gone'. That paragraph was written by this board to constrain exactly this moment, so its three limbs are tested rather than its conclusion inherited. BUY ABOVE THE OFFER: does not happen - the fill is at 159.19, below the limit and below the strike. INTO A DECLINE: there is no decline - the bid is 0.06% under the settled close and 0.08 ABOVE the bid the entry was struck on, and the session's move has been a fade from a high set AFTER the entry, not a break from it. THE LEVEL IS GONE: it is not gone, it is the level currently quoted on both sides. What yesterday's paragraph describes is a tape that falls THROUGH a limit and keeps going, leaving an order stranded above a falling offer; what is on the screen is a 0.17 oscillation around the strike on a 0.29-wide spread. The rationale does not fire, and a rule is read by its rationale rather than by its silhouette.

THE BRIGHT LINE IS NAMED HERE SO THE NEXT HOURLY DOES NOT HAVE TO RE-DERIVE IT UNDER TIME PRESSURE. The downward kill for this entry is the 154.58 early warning, already written before the outcome and already sitting above the mechanical stop precisely so the thesis breaks before the stop does. If TGT trades below 154.58 the reclaim this entry is built on has failed on the day it was bought, and the specification is killed by appending whether or not the limit is still nominally reachable. Between 159.19 and 154.58 the answer is confirm. That is the whole test, it needs only the tape and one number, and it is written down so no run has to invent it at 13:17.

THE LIMIT IS NOT RAISED, AND IT IS NOT LOWERED EITHER - WHICH IS THE HALF OF THAT RULE THIS BOARD HAS NEVER HAD OCCASION TO STATE. Nothing has got away, so the familiar temptation is absent. The unfamiliar one is present instead: a marketable limit invites tidying it down to 159.19 to record a cleaner fill. That is the same act as raising it, performed in the flattering direction, and it would rewrite a level struck in advance to match a quote pulled afterward. Confirming a specification is not improving it, in either direction. The 159.36 stands exactly as written and simply fills better than it reads.

NO EXIT IS DUE AND THAT IS VERIFIED RATHER THAN INHERITED. Equity positions and option positions were BOTH queried live against the mandate account at 10:23 and BOTH LISTS ARE EMPTY. With nothing held there is no target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window that can be reached this hour - not one level went unchecked, because none exists. ZERO equity orders exist in this account with a created_at floor of 2026-08-20, so the 159.36 limit has not been executed or partially executed by anyone and agentTrades stays 0. Portfolio pulled live: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits, ZERO unsettled, unchanged from the 09:43 read because nothing has traded. The specification is the only claim on that cash, so one of four concurrent slots is used.

A NOTIFICATION WAS SENT OUTSIDE THE FIVE LITERAL TRIGGERS AND IS RECORDED AS A JUDGEMENT CALL RATHER THAN AS A TRIGGER THAT FIRED. Step 5 lists five conditions and none is met: no exit spec was published, nothing was killed, the staleness guard was cleared, the connector attached, no level was hit-and-missed on a book that holds nothing, and the specification has five hours to run rather than one. The list would have this slot stay silent, and the stated cost of the unnecessary ping - that it teaches an operator to ignore the necessary one - is real and was weighed. Against it: five consecutive specifications have now expired unexecuted, and this board's own 8/19 pre-close, having exhausted the window explanation and the notification explanation, concluded that what remained was that nobody was at the desk during the forty morning minutes when the number was actually there. THESE ARE THOSE MINUTES, and they are better than those were, because the offer is below the limit rather than merely touching it. The content is new rather than a restatement of the 09:47 delivery - the spec is not merely alive, it is fillable now and cheaper than struck - and it is information with a fuse on it. A duplicate ping is the cheap error and a sixth silent expiry is the expensive one. One line, no account identifier.

NO NEW ENTRY IS PROPOSED AND NONE IS OWED. This slot is exits-only, the standing default is no trade, the bar for a mid-session entry is higher than the open's by design, and the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text - it was discharged at 09:47 with a not-forced entry, five of six with item 3 not applicable, that is still live.

THE FOUR OTHER WATCH ROWS WERE RE-QUOTED IN THE SAME CALL SO THEY SHARE ONE TIMESTAMP, AND ONE OF THEM SETTLES A QUESTION. SQM is 76.05 bid / 76.46 ask, +0.89% against the 75.38 close, holding its day-2 gain - and its 0.41 spread is 0.54% of mark against TGT's 0.182%, which is the margin it was ranked second on and the margin is unchanged. AS is 33.05 bid / 33.08 ask, -2.85% against the 34.02 close and now 0.65 BELOW the 33.70 early warning its own 8/19 entry wrote in advance. That is the second session it has traded through its own invalidation, and it confirms this morning's refusal to revive it: the name the board chased for two sessions is now 0.82 below the limit that never filled, and buying it here would be buying a setup its author already declared dead. SMCI is 37.43 bid / 37.46 ask, +2.32%, the ask 0.78 under the dead 38.24 limit on a nineteenth test, still not revived because a lower price never supplied the catalyst item 1 wanted. KLAR is 14.19 bid / 14.20 ask, -3.66%, a third consecutive down day and still no base, which is the precondition any entry there would need.

ONE NUMBER IN THE OPEN'S OWN ENTRY DOES NOT RECONCILE AGAINST THIS RUN'S FEED, AND IT IS FLAGGED RATHER THAN QUIETLY REPAIRED OR QUIETLY REPEATED. The 09:47 entry states 672,800 TGT shares in the first fifteen minutes. The five-minute regular-hours bars this run pulled sum to 259,956 through 09:45 and 604,422 cumulative through 10:20 - the fifteen-minute figure is roughly 2.5x this feed's. This run cannot see which endpoint the open used and does not assert it was wrong; the two may be different aggregations of the same session. It changes no decision here, because limb one of yesterday's written test asked only for volume LIGHTER than the 2.16M TGT did in thirteen minutes yesterday, and both readings clear that by a wide margin. It is recorded for the retro to reconcile, because a published number that a later run cannot reproduce is worth more as a flag than as a silence.

MECHANICS. Fired 10:21 ET against the 10:17 slot, four minutes late and sixteen minutes inside the 20-minute staleness guard. The clock was cross-checked against the broker rather than trusted: venue_bid_time reads 14:24:53.879Z against a local 10:24 ET, an exact -4 EDT offset, on a machine this project has already caught reporting a clock nearly eight hours slow. The connector attached and the scope preflight matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY against the connector list - one account, unique, cash, agentic-allowed - and every other account was discarded unread; no identifier appears in this file, the commit, or the notification. Actions 0 - this run has no order authority, placed nothing, and allowOrderPlacement remains false.

grade.text: PASS, and the specific credit is for reporting a round trip the entry could have omitted. The slot's job was done on evidence: both position lists queried live, portfolio re-read rather than carried, and the specification re-quoted against a timestamped market at 14:24:53.879Z rather than confirmed on yesterday's numbers. The finding that the limit sat 0.17 THROUGH the offer and would fill immediately at better than struck is the correct and useful reading, and the entry got the mechanics right - a limit fills at the offer, so the operator was never being asked to pay 159.36. What earns the grade is the paragraph after it: TGT had run to a 161.28 session high and faded the whole move back, and this entry recorded the round trip rather than presenting a marketable limit as a level the tape had come to. FLAG, AND IT IS THE DAY'S PROCESS FINDING RATHER THAN A FAULT IN THIS ENTRY. This run sent a notification it described as outside the written trigger list, on the reasoning that a marketable limit is exactly when the operator can act. That judgement looks right. But the next two runs cited it as a one-off and declined to repeat it, so three notification policies ran inside four hours, and the trigger list this board is applying appears in no rulebook. Graded outcome-blind: the level was reachable in these minutes and unreachable in every later hour, and none of that bears on whether confirming here was correct.

entries.head: No exit is due against a verified-flat book, and the 159.36 TGT specification is re-quoted and CONFIRMED for a second hour - but it has stopped being marketable, the limit now rests inside the spread instead of filling on entry, and it is neither raised the eight cents that would restore the fill nor lowered
entries.body: THE EXITS HALF OF THIS SLOT IS ANSWERED BY EVIDENCE RATHER THAN BY SILENCE. Equity positions and option positions were BOTH queried live at 11:22 ET and BOTH LISTS ARE EMPTY. There is no target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window that could have been reached this hour, so not one level went unchecked - there are none to check. Portfolio re-read live rather than carried forward: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits, ZERO unsettled. Zero equity orders exist with a created_at floor of 2026-08-20, so the 159.36 limit has not been executed or partially executed by anyone, agentTrades stays 0, and the specification is still unowned. THE RE-VALIDATION DUTY IS THE WHOLE JOB THIS HOUR AND THE ANSWER IS CONFIRM - WITH ONE MATERIAL CHANGE THAT IS REPORTED AS THE HEADLINE RATHER THAN BURIED. TGT is 159.26 bid / 159.44 ask at 15:22:49.192Z, last trade 159.34 at 15:22:47.420Z, a 0.18 spread or 0.113% of mark - the tightest this name has quoted all session - against the 159.00 official settled close. The bid is +0.16% on the day and 0.44 ABOVE the 158.82 bid the entry was struck on at 09:47. THE LIMIT IS NO LONGER MARKETABLE AND THE PROBABILITY OF EXECUTION FELL THIS HOUR. At 10:24 the offer was 159.19 and the 159.36 limit sat 0.17 through it, so an order entered then filled immediately and cheaper than struck. At 11:22 the offer is 159.44 and the limit sits INSIDE the spread - 0.10 above the bid, 0.08 below the offer. An order entered now RESTS. Last hour's run was entitled to call that window fillable; it has closed, and repeating last hour's sentence would have been the easy and dishonest option. What has to happen for a fill is a single 0.08 tick down in the offer, and the tape has crossed 159.36 in both directions in six of the last nine five-minute bars, so this is a live resting order rather than a dead one. THE KILL TEST IS APPLIED IN FULL AND IT IS EASIER TO PASS THAN LAST HOUR'S, WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION FROM THE FILL PROSPECT AND SO IS WORTH SEPARATING OUT. A specification dies when its invalidation triggers, when its limit is no longer inside the spread, or when the setup it described has left the tape. Limb one fails: 154.58 has not been retested. Limb two fails PLAINLY for the first time today - 159.36 IS inside 159.26/159.44, word for word - where at 10:24 limb two was met on its face, in the downward direction, and had to be argued through limb by limb before the confirmation could stand. The test that needed a full paragraph an hour ago now needs one line. Limb three fails: the level quoted on both sides right now is the level the entry was reasoned on, and the day-2 structure of gap down, shake out to 154.58, reclaim is intact, with the name oscillating around its own strike rather than trending away from it. BOTH WRITTEN INVALIDATIONS ARE UNTOUCHED AND THAT IS CHECKED AGAINST BARS RATHER THAN ASSERTED. The early warning is a trade below 154.58, today's opening-bar low and the floor of the shakeout this entry is built on. 154.58 is the low of the 09:30 bar itself and nothing has traded below it since: across the twelve five-minute bars printed since the 10:24 check the lowest low is 157.965, in the 10:40 bar, leaving the bid 4.68 or 2.94% clear of the warning. The outright void is a close below 152.48, the pre-print close whose reclaim is the whole thesis, 6.78 below the bid and untestable before the bell. The 146.61 mechanical stop is 12.65 away and cannot be reached on a position that does not exist. THE EIGHT CENTS ARE THE POINT OF THE HOUR. Raising the limit from 159.36 to 159.44 would restore an immediate fill and cost the operator sixteen cents across two shares. It is refused. A limit may never be raised to chase, and the fact that this particular chase is trivially cheap is the argument FOR the rule rather than an exception to it - a discipline that binds only when it is expensive is not a discipline, and the board that raises a limit by eight cents on a Thursday is the board that raises one by eighty on a Friday. It is not lowered either: tidying a resting limit down toward the bid is the same act performed in the flattering direction. The 159.36 stands as written for the fourth consecutive reading, and the operator is told plainly that it is now a resting order rather than a fill. NO NEW ENTRY IS PROPOSED AND NONE IS OWED, INCLUDING AGAINST THE NAME THAT IS BEATING THE ONE THAT WAS BOUGHT. This slot is exits-only, the standing default is no trade, the bar for a mid-session entry is higher than the open's by design, and the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text - it was discharged at 09:47 with a not-forced five-of-six entry that is still live. SQM, ranked second this morning on liquidity, is 77.61 bid at 15:22:40.162Z, +2.96% against the 75.38 close, while TGT is +0.16% - the passed-over name has taken two full points of relative performance in one hour. It is recorded rather than acted on, and it is recorded prominently because the uncomfortable half is the half that grades the decision. Chasing it now would fail item 2 on its own terms: it is quoted 1.36 above the 76.27 day-2 high the open recorded, which is buying after the move rather than on the reclaim, and its 0.373% spread is still three times TGT's. THE OTHER THREE WATCH ROWS WERE RE-QUOTED IN THE SAME CALL SO THEY SHARE ONE TIMESTAMP, AND TWO OF THEM PAID THIS HOUR. AS is 32.55 bid / 32.57 ask, -4.32% against the 34.02 close and down another 0.50 in the hour - now 1.15 BELOW the 33.70 early warning its own 8/19 entry wrote and 1.32 below the 33.87 limit that expired unexecuted. Had this board revived that level when the name first came back to it, the position would already be through its written invalidation. SMCI is 36.08 bid / 36.10 ask, -1.37%, a 1.35 reversal from the +2.32% it showed an hour ago; the dead 38.24 limit went from 0.78 below the offer to 2.14 above it inside one hourly window, which is the twentieth refusal being proved out in real time rather than merely restated. KLAR is 14.07 bid / 14.09 ask, -4.48%, a third down day with no base. The twenty-four-row candidate table is deliberately NOT re-struck: its rows carry the open's 13:42-13:47Z bids, and re-quoting only the five names this run touched would publish a two-timestamp board that reads as one. NO NOTIFICATION WAS SENT AND THAT IS A DELIBERATE REVERSAL OF LAST HOUR'S JUDGEMENT CALL, RECORDED AS ONE. None of the five literal triggers fires: no exit was published, nothing was killed, the guard was cleared, the connector attached, and the spec is four hours from expiry rather than in its last hour. The 10:21 run sent one anyway, outside the list, on the reasoning that the level was live, cheaper than struck, and actionable in exactly those minutes. That reasoning does not survive this hour, because the specific fact it rested on has reversed - the limit is no longer marketable and there is nothing time-critical to act on. Pinging again to say the fill got harder would be the duplicate that teaches an operator to ignore the next one, and the next one is the 14:17 or 15:17 last-hour warning that the rulebook does mandate. Silence here is what keeps that ping loud. Actions 0 - this run has no order authority, placed nothing, and allowOrderPlacement remains false. The scope preflight matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY against the connector list; every other account was discarded unread and no identifier appears in this file, the commit, or anywhere else. Fired 11:21 ET against the 11:17 slot, four minutes late and sixteen minutes inside the 20-minute guard; the clock was cross-checked against the broker rather than trusted, with venue_bid_time at 15:22:49.192Z against a local 11:22 ET confirming the exact -4 EDT offset on a machine this project has already caught running badly slow. Nothing outside data/ was staged: the working tree still carries uncommitted changes to scripts/validate.mjs, README.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md plus untracked scripts/toolcall-log.mjs, scripts/sim.mjs, docs/TOOLLOG.md and docs/SIM.md, none of them this run's work, and the gate was run against that stricter local validator without this run editing or weakening it.

grade.text: PASS. Flat book verified live rather than inherited, and the re-validation duty discharged on a fresh quote. The entry's value is that it reported the direction of travel against its own interest: the limit had stopped being marketable and now rested inside the spread, which is a step AWAY from a fill, and the entry led with that rather than repeating the previous hour's confirmation in a softer register. The eight cents that would have restored the fill were refused, and refused on the right ground - a limit may never be raised to chase, and the triviality of the amount is the argument for the rule rather than an exception to it. Nothing here is asserted that a run reading the same tape could not check.

entries.head: Flat book so no exit is due, and the TGT specification is CONFIRMED for a third hour - the limit has slipped 0.05 BELOW the bid, so the kill test was met on its face in the away direction and is decided in writing rather than waved through
entries.body:
NO EXIT IS DUE AND IT IS VERIFIED RATHER THAN INHERITED. Equity positions and option positions were both queried live at 12:22 ET against the mandated account and both lists are empty. There is no target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window that can be reached this hour, because there is no position. Portfolio: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, ZERO unsettled. Zero equity orders exist on a created_at floor of 2026-08-20, so the 159.36 limit has not filled or partially filled and agentTrades stays 0.

THE RE-VALIDATION DUTY IS DISCHARGED AND THE ANSWER IS CONFIRM. TGT is 159.41 bid / 159.53 ask at 16:22:40.785Z, last 159.47, a 0.12 spread or 0.075% of mark - the tightest quote of the session - and +0.26% against the 159.00 settled close. The bid is 0.59 ABOVE the 158.82 bid the entry was struck on at 09:47.

THE HOUR'S REAL NEWS IS THE THIRD CONSECUTIVE STEP AWAY FROM A FILL, AND IT IS STATED PLAINLY RATHER THAN BURIED UNDER A CONFIRMATION. At 10:24 the 159.36 limit sat 0.17 through a 159.19 offer and would have filled on entry at better than struck. At 11:22 it sat inside a 159.26/159.44 spread and rested. At 12:22 it sits 0.05 UNDER the 159.41 bid and waits for the market to come back to it. Every hour has moved the same way. The operator is being told the direction of travel, not just the current state.

THE KILL TEST IS APPLIED IN FULL AND LIMB TWO IS MET IN THE AWAY DIRECTION FOR THE FIRST TIME TODAY. A specification dies when its invalidation triggers, when its limit is no longer inside the spread, or when the setup it described has left the tape. Limb one fails: 154.58 has not been retested. Limb three fails: the gap-down, shake-out, reclaim structure is intact and the name is oscillating rather than trending away. Limb two is met word for word - 159.36 is not inside 159.41/159.53. That is materially different from the 10:24 reading, where the limit was outside the spread on the MARKETABLE side and the operator would have paid less than specified. Outside on the AWAY side is the shape of a name that got away, which is the case this rulebook is most suspicious of, so it does not get to pass on the same reasoning the marketable case used.

IT DOES NOT FIRE, AND THE REASON IS EVIDENCE FROM THE TAPE RATHER THAN RELUCTANCE TO LOSE THE ENTRY. Limb two exists to kill a level the tape has abandoned. This tape has not abandoned this level. Six of the twelve five-minute bars since the 11:22 check printed lows at or below 159.36 - 159.170, 159.145, 159.145, 159.270, 159.290 and 159.330 - and the last of those is the 12:15 bar, SEVEN MINUTES before this quote. The hour ranged 159.145 to 160.060, a 0.92 span. Five cents of drift inside that is oscillation around the strike, not departure from it. A level that printed seven minutes ago is reachable by one tick.

THE AWAY-SIDE BRIGHT LINE IS NAMED SO THE NEXT HOURLY DOES NOT RE-DERIVE IT AND SO THE RETRO CAN OVERRULE IT ON THE RECORD. The kill for this specification, in the away direction, is the level CEASING TO PRINT: if a full hourly window passes with no five-minute bar trading at or below 159.36, the tape has left the level and the specification should be killed rather than left resting to expire quietly at 15:30. That is a test of an hour of tape, not of the quote at one instant, and it is this run's judgement rather than something the operator wrote down. It is recorded here precisely so it can be graded and, if wrong, overruled by name.

BOTH WRITTEN INVALIDATIONS ARE UNTOUCHED AND ARE CHECKED AGAINST BARS RATHER THAN ASSERTED. The early warning is a trade below 154.58, today's opening-bar low. Nothing has traded below it since, and the lowest low across the twelve five-minute bars since the 11:22 check is 159.145, leaving the bid 4.83 or 3.03% clear - the widest cushion this specification has carried today. The outright void is a close below 152.48, 6.93 below the bid and untestable before the bell. The 146.61 mechanical stop is 12.80 away and unreachable on a position that does not exist.

THE FIVE CENTS ARE REFUSED, AS THE EIGHT WERE AN HOUR AGO AND AS EVERY SUCH TEMPTATION HAS BEEN. Meeting the bid at 159.41 would restore an immediate fill for ten cents across two shares. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away, and the triviality of this particular chase is the argument FOR the rule rather than an exception to it: a discipline that only binds when it is expensive is not a discipline. This is the third consecutive hour the same small raise has been declined, and declining it is the only reason the number in this specification still means what it meant at 09:47. It is not lowered either - tidying a resting limit toward the bid is the same act in the flattering direction. The 159.36 stands as written for a fifth consecutive reading.

NO NEW ENTRY IS PROPOSED AND NONE IS OWED. This slot is exits-only, the standing default is no trade, the mid-session bar is higher than the open's by design, and the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text - it was discharged at 09:47 with a not-forced five-of-six entry that is still live.

THE OTHER FOUR WATCH ROWS WERE RE-QUOTED IN THE SAME CALL. SQM is 77.40 bid, +2.68% against TGT's +0.26%: the passed-over name is 2.42 points ahead on the day and stopped widening this hour. It is recorded rather than chased, because item 2 refuses it on its own terms at 1.13 above the 76.27 day-2 high the open recorded. AS is 32.80 bid, -3.59%, bouncing 0.25 off the hour's low and still 0.90 BELOW the 33.70 early warning its own 8/19 entry wrote - a partial bounce inside a broken structure is a harder test of the no-revival rule than a fall is, and the answer does not change with the direction of the tick. NO NOTIFICATION WAS SENT AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. grade.text: PASS, AND IT IS THE ENTRY THAT EARNED THE DAY. Everything routine was done - positions and portfolio verified live, zero orders confirmed against a dated floor, invalidations checked against bars rather than asserted, and the five cents refused. What lifts it above the other confirmations is that it held a limit sitting BELOW the bid, which is the reading on which killing was available, and refused to settle the question on one instant's quote. Instead it named a tape test in advance - the specification dies if a full hourly window passes with no five-minute bar trading at or below 159.36 - and said explicitly why it was writing it before the answer was known: so that the run holding the answer would not be free to decide after seeing the price. THE FLAG IS ON THE TEST'S CONTENT AND NOT ON THE ACT. The test measures absence of prints, while the rationale it was given was a resting bid under a RISING market - two different conditions. That mismatch is what let it fire an hour after its own rationale expired, and it was visible when the test was written rather than only in hindsight, which is why it is graded here rather than left to the outcome. The recommendation is in tonight's ledger and is the operator's to take or leave.

entries.head: Flat book so no exit is due, and the TGT specification is CONFIRMED for a fourth hour - but the name has walked 1.06 above the limit to a session high, and the away-side drought test written an hour ago will fire at 13:45 unless the tape comes back
entries.body:
NO EXIT IS DUE AND THAT IS VERIFIED RATHER THAN INHERITED. Equity positions and option positions were BOTH queried live at 13:23 and BOTH LISTS ARE EMPTY, so there is no target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window that can be reached this hour - not one level went unchecked, because none exists. Portfolio pulled live: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits, ZERO unsettled. ZERO equity orders exist with a created_at floor of 2026-08-20, so the 159.36 limit has not been executed or partially executed by anyone and agentTrades stays 0.

THE RE-VALIDATION DUTY IS DISCHARGED AND THE ANSWER IS CONFIRM, BUT THE HEADLINE IS THAT THE NAME HAS LEFT THE LEVEL. TGT is 160.42 bid / 160.58 ask at 17:23:00.816Z, last trade 160.54, a 0.16 spread or 0.100% of mark, against the 159.00 official settled close - so the bid is +0.89% on the day and 1.60 ABOVE the 158.82 bid the entry was struck on at 09:47. The 13:15 five-minute bar set a 160.68 session high eight minutes before the quote.

THE 159.36 LIMIT IS NOW 1.06 UNDER THE BID, A TWENTYFOLD WIDENING FROM LAST HOUR'S 0.05, AND THAT IS THE FOURTH CONSECUTIVE HOUR EXECUTION PROBABILITY HAS FALLEN. Through the offer and filling on entry at 10:24; inside the spread and resting at 11:22; 0.05 under the bid at 12:22; 1.06 under it now. Every hour has moved the same way and this run says so rather than repeating the previous sentence in a softer register. What has to happen for a fill is no longer one tick - it is a 0.66% retrace.

THE KILL TEST IS APPLIED IN FULL AND LIMB TWO IS MET FOR A SECOND CONSECUTIVE HOUR, ON THE AWAY SIDE, BY TWENTY TIMES THE MARGIN. A specification dies when its invalidation triggers, when its limit is no longer inside the spread, or when the setup it described has left the tape. Limb one fails: 154.58 has not been retested and the bid is 3.64% above it. Limb two is met word for word - 159.36 is not inside 160.42/160.58 - and outside on the away side is the shape of a name that got away, which is the case this rulebook is most suspicious of. LIMB THREE IS THE ONE WORTH ARGUING AND IT ALSO FAILS, FOR AN UNCOMFORTABLE REASON: the gap-down, shake-out, reclaim structure is not merely intact, it is PAYING. A day-2 continuation printing a session high is the thesis being right rather than the setup leaving the tape. The entry was correct and it did not fill, which is a different failure from being wrong and is graded as one.

IT DOES NOT FIRE, AND THE DECIDING REASON IS A TEST WRITTEN AN HOUR AGO BEFORE ANYONE KNEW THIS HOUR'S ANSWER. The 12:22 run named the away-side kill as the level CEASING TO PRINT for a full hourly window - deliberately a test of the tape across an hour rather than of the quote at one instant, and deliberately written in advance so that this run would not be free to decide it after seeing the price. It does not fire on either available reading of that sentence. READING ONE, the hour since the last print: the level last printed in the 12:40 bar at a 159.260 low, 38 minutes before this quote, so the drought clock reads 38 minutes and not 60. READING TWO, the window between checks: FOUR of the eleven bars completed since the 12:22 check traded at or below 159.36, at lows of 159.090, 159.070, 158.950 and 159.260. Two readings, one answer, and neither of them is this run's invention. That is the whole value of having written the test down first.

BUT THE DROUGHT HAS STARTED RUNNING FOR THE FIRST TIME TODAY AND THE HANDOFF IS EXPLICIT, BECAUSE THE NEXT HOUR IS WHERE THIS PROBABLY ENDS. Seven consecutive bars from 12:45 to 13:20 printed lows of 159.465, 159.930, 160.060, 159.840, 159.850, 159.770 and 160.000 - every one above the limit, and the sequence rising rather than oscillating. IF NO FIVE-MINUTE BAR TRADES AT OR BELOW 159.36 BY 13:45 ET, BOTH READINGS OF THE BRIGHT LINE ARE MET AND THE 14:17 RUN SHOULD KILL THIS SPECIFICATION - by APPENDING a did entry, never by editing the 09:47 will entry, which is append-only - rather than leave a resting bid under a rising market to expire quietly at 15:30. A specification that dies by neglect teaches the record nothing. One killed on a test written an hour before it fired teaches it the test.

BOTH WRITTEN INVALIDATIONS ARE UNTOUCHED AND ARE CHECKED AGAINST BARS RATHER THAN ASSERTED. The early warning is a trade below 154.58, the opening-bar low; nothing has traded below it since, and the lowest low across the eleven bars printed since the 12:22 check is 158.950 in the 12:35 bar, leaving the bid 5.84 or 3.64% clear - the widest cushion this spec has carried today. The outright void is a close below 152.48, 7.94 below the bid and untestable before the bell. The 146.61 mechanical stop is 13.81 away and unreachable on a position that does not exist.

THE 1.06 IS REFUSED AS THE 0.05 AND THE 0.08 WERE, AND THIS IS THE FIRST ONE THAT COSTS REAL MONEY TO HONOUR. Meeting the bid at 160.42 would restore an immediate fill for 2.12 across two shares - and unlike the previous three hours, the name being chased is genuinely running. That is precisely the case the rule exists for. The cheapness of the earlier temptations was the easy version of this discipline; a rule that binds only while it is free is not a discipline at all. Fourth consecutive hour, fourth refusal, and it is the only reason the number in this specification still means what it meant at 09:47. IT IS NOT LOWERED EITHER - tidying a resting limit toward a bid that has run away from it is the same act wearing a flattering label. The 159.36 stands as written for a sixth consecutive reading, and the operator is told plainly it is a resting bid 0.66% under a market making session highs, not a fill.

NO NEW ENTRY IS PROPOSED AND NONE IS OWED. This slot is exits-only, the standing default is no trade, the mid-session bar is higher than the open's by design, and the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text - discharged at 09:47 with a not-forced five-of-six entry that is still live.

THE FOUR OTHER WATCH ROWS SHARE THE SAME QUOTE CALL, AND FOR THE FIRST TIME TODAY ONE OF THEM CUTS IN THE BOARD'S FAVOUR. SQM is 77.54 bid, +2.87% against TGT's +0.89%, so the passed-over name leads by 1.97 points against 2.42 an hour ago - it added 0.19 while TGT added 0.63. Three consecutive hours this board recorded the uncomfortable direction of that comparison; this hour it narrowed, and reporting only the flattering half now would be the same dishonesty in reverse. It is still not chased: quoted 1.27 above the 76.27 day-2 high the open recorded, item 2 refuses it on its own terms. AS is 32.94 bid, -3.17%, bouncing for a SECOND consecutive hour and now 0.39 off the hour's low but still 0.76 BELOW the 33.70 early warning its own 8/19 entry wrote. Two hours of recovery is when a broken level starts being re-described as a shakeout and a revival starts to look like judgement; the answer does not change with the duration of a bounce any more than it changed with its direction. SMCI is 35.95 bid, -1.72%, recovering 0.25, with the dead 38.24 limit 2.28 above the offer against 0.78 BELOW it three hours ago - up, down and up again inside one morning, and none of it repairs a missing catalyst. KLAR is 13.89 bid, -5.70%, lower again at every hourly check today and 0.43 through the 14.32 level, still no base on a third down day. The twenty-four-row candidate table is deliberately NOT re-struck, because re-quoting only the five names this run touched would publish a two-timestamp board reading as one.

NO NOTIFICATION WAS SENT AND THAT IS DELIBERATE, RECORDED SO THE RETRO CAN OVERRULE IT. None of the five literal triggers fires: nothing was published, nothing was killed, the guard was cleared, the connector attached, and the spec has more than two hours to run rather than being in its last hour. The 10:21 run sent one outside the list because the level was live and cheaper than struck in those specific minutes; that fact has now reversed three times over. A ping saying the fill got harder for a fourth hour is the duplicate that teaches an operator to ignore the next one - and on the drought arithmetic above, the next one is likely to be a KILL at 14:17, which is a trigger the rulebook does mandate. Silence here is what keeps that ping loud.

Actions 0 - this run has no order authority, placed nothing, and allowOrderPlacement remains false. Nothing outside data/ was staged: the working tree still carries uncommitted changes to scripts/validate.mjs, README.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md plus untracked scripts/toolcall-log.mjs, scripts/sim.mjs, docs/TOOLLOG.md and docs/SIM.md, none of them this run's work, and the gate was run against that stricter local validator without this run editing or weakening it.

grade.text: PASS. The re-validation is honest in the direction that hurts: the entry led with the name having LEFT the level, quantified the fourth consecutive hourly fall in execution probability - through the offer, inside the spread, five cents under the bid, now 1.06 under it - and refused to let a confirmation read as good news. The kill test was applied in full rather than gestured at, limb by limb, and it did not fire for the right reason: the test written an hour earlier is about the tape across an hour, not the quote at an instant, and this run was not free to re-derive it. The drought was then dated, the 13:45 deadline written down, and the handoff made explicit so the next hour would inherit an answer rather than a judgement call. The 2.12 chase was refused when it was the first one that cost real money, and the entry said so - the earlier refusals were the easy version. It also recorded that SQM narrowed its lead this hour, after three hours of reporting the uncomfortable direction of that comparison, which is the same discipline pointed the other way.

entries.head: The 159.36 TGT specification is WITHDRAWN - the hour-long away-side drought test written in advance fired at 13:45 ET and is honoured even though the name has since come back to within 0.38 of the limit
entries.body:
NO EXIT IS DUE AND IT IS VERIFIED RATHER THAN INHERITED. Equity positions and option positions were BOTH queried live at 14:22 ET against the mandated account and BOTH LISTS ARE EMPTY. There is no target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window that can be reached this hour, because there is no position. Portfolio pulled live: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, so the whole balance is settled and no good-faith violation is reachable. Zero equity orders exist with a created_at floor of 2026-08-20, so the 159.36 specification was never executed, never partially executed, and agentTrades stays 0.

THE SPECIFICATION IS KILLED, AND THIS IS THE FIRST ONE THIS BOARD HAS EVER WITHDRAWN RATHER THAN LEFT TO EXPIRE. Five previous specifications - SMCI on 8/13, UPST on 8/14, SMCI again on 8/17, AS on 8/18 and AS again on 8/19 - all died the same way, by running out of clock with nobody deciding anything. The 2026-08-18 rule change exists because of that pattern and says the hourly runs must confirm or kill. Four hours of this session confirmed. This one kills, and it does so with sixty-eight minutes still on the clock rather than at 15:29.

THE TEST THAT FIRED WAS NOT THIS RUN'S. The 12:22 run, holding a limit 0.05 below the bid, refused to decide the away-side question on a single instant's quote and named a tape test instead: the specification dies when a full hourly window passes with NO five-minute bar trading at or below 159.36. The 13:22 run found the drought running for the first time, dated it, and wrote the deadline down - if no bar trades at or below 159.36 by 13:45 ET, kill by appending. Both runs said explicitly why they were writing it in advance: so that the run holding the answer would not be free to decide after seeing the price. That is the only reason this kill is worth anything.

IT FIRED, AND IT FIRED ON BARS RATHER THAN ON ASSERTION. The level last printed in the 12:40 five-minute bar, at a 159.260 low. The twelve bars from 12:45 through 13:44 printed lows of 159.465, 159.930, 160.060, 159.840, 159.850, 159.770, 160.000, 160.340, 159.890, 160.160, 159.570 and 159.5658. Not one of them is at or below 159.36. The full hourly window completed at 13:45 ET, thirty-seven minutes before this run quoted anything, and BOTH readings the 12:22 run offered are met: hour-since-last-print reads 65 minutes at the deadline and 97 minutes now, against a 60-minute test; window-between-checks returns zero qualifying bars out of the eleven completed since 13:23, against four out of eleven an hour ago.

AND NOW THE PART THAT MAKES THIS HARD, STATED FIRST AND NOT BURIED. TGT HAS COME BACK. It is 159.74 bid / 159.87 ask at 18:22:55.170568587Z, last 159.7301, a 0.13 spread or 0.081% of mark - still the tightest quote on this board - and +0.47% against the 159.00 settled close. AN HOUR AGO THE LIMIT WAS 1.06 UNDER THE BID; IT IS NOW 0.38 UNDER IT. The 13:35 bar traded down to 159.570, the 13:55 bar to 159.440 - EIGHT CENTS above the limit - and the last seven bars have oscillated in a 159.44-159.93 band directly above it. This specification is closer to filling at the moment it is withdrawn than at any moment since 12:22, and the operator is told that in the same breath as the kill rather than after it.

IT IS KILLED ANYWAY, AND THE REASONING IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THE ENTRY. A pre-committed test that is set aside when the price comes back is not a test; it is a formality that fires only when it agrees with the run reading it. If this board declines to honour a bright line thirty-seven minutes after it triggered because the tape got friendlier in the interval, then no test any run writes in advance means anything, and every future handoff becomes a suggestion. That cost is larger and more permanent than one foregone fill on a two-share position. The 13:22 run gave up its own freedom to decide this so that the 14:17 run would not have any either. Taking that freedom back after seeing a better price is the same move as raising a limit to chase, wearing the opposite sign.

THE HONEST COUNTER-ARGUMENT, RECORDED BECAUSE THE RETRO SHOULD NOT HAVE TO DISCOVER IT. The test's stated RATIONALE was a resting bid under a RISING market - and the market stopped rising at 13:20 and has been coming back ever since. Read by its purpose rather than its words, the test arguably no longer applies. That reading is available, it is not stupid, and it is refused for one reason: it requires this run to reinterpret a rule by its spirit at exactly the moment when the spirit happens to favour the outcome this run would otherwise prefer. A rule is worth something when it binds against preference. This one binds now or it never did.

WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS KILL WRONG, WRITTEN BEFORE THE ANSWER IS KNOWN. If TGT trades at or below 159.36 before 15:30 ET, this withdrawal cost a fill that the untouched specification would have taken, and the retro should grade it as a loss of process against a gain of discipline rather than pretending the two are the same. It needs a further 0.38, or 0.24%, on a tape that has already supplied 159.440. THAT IS A LIVE POSSIBILITY AND IT IS NOT BEING TALKED DOWN. What the retro should also weigh against it: a fill at 15:20 is not the entry the 09:47 reasoning described, the entry itself recorded that the honest expectation was the time stop rather than the 191.23 target, and the position is 31.6% of the account on a name whose thesis was a day-2 continuation that has now spent an entire afternoon going sideways.

THE LIMIT IS NOT RAISED ON THE WAY OUT, WHICH IS THE POINT OF WITHDRAWING RATHER THAN RE-STRIKING. Meeting the 159.74 bid would restore an immediate fill for 0.76 across two shares - cheaper than the 2.12 it would have cost an hour ago, and that cheapness is exactly what makes it tempting. It is refused for the sixth consecutive reading. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away, and the fact that the name came most of the way back does not convert the chase into a bargain. The 159.36 stands as the number this board asked for at 09:47 and it leaves the board unmodified.

BOTH WRITTEN INVALIDATIONS WERE UNTOUCHED AT THE KILL, AND THAT IS RECORDED SO THE REASON FOR THE WITHDRAWAL IS NOT LATER MISREAD AS THE THESIS BREAKING. The early warning is a trade below 154.58, today's opening-bar low: nothing has traded below it since, and the lowest five-minute low of the entire hour since the last check is 159.440, leaving the bid 5.16 or 3.34% clear. The outright void is a close below 152.48, 7.26 below the bid and untestable before the bell. THE THESIS DID NOT BREAK. The specification died of a drought at its own limit, which is a different fact, and the difference is what tomorrow's open needs: TGT remains a legitimate candidate on structure, and any entry it writes must be struck on tomorrow's quotes and tomorrow's reasoning rather than by reviving 159.36.

THE REST OF THE BOARD, RE-QUOTED AT 14:22 AND UNCHANGED IN CONCLUSION. SQM 77.44 bid / 77.59 ask, +2.73%, against TGT's +0.47% - the passed-over name widened its lead back to 2.26 points from 1.97, and it is still not chased, because this slot is exits-only and item 2 refuses a name up 2.73% on day 2 regardless. AS 32.58 bid / 32.60 ask, -4.23%, and the two-hour bounce this board declined to re-describe as a shakeout HAS FAILED - the name is 0.36 below last hour's bid and 1.12 below the 33.70 level that broke, so the refusal to revive 33.87 is 1.27 in the money. SMCI 36.57 bid, -0.03%, recovered to flat, with the dead 38.24 limit 1.66 above the offer: refused for a twenty-third time. KLAR 14.00 bid, -4.96%, a third down day with still no base.

NO NEW ENTRY IS PROPOSED AND THE BAR FOR ONE IS NOT LOWERED BY HAVING JUST CANCELLED SOMETHING. Withdrawing a specification does not create an obligation to replace it. The daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text and was discharged at 09:47; this slot is exits-only, the bar for a mid-session entry is higher than the open's by design, and nothing on the board clears it. The account ends this hour flat, with 1009.16 settled and no live specification for the first time today.

grade.text: PASS, AND THE STRONGEST ENTRY THIS BOARD HAS PUBLISHED. It honoured a bright line written by a different run, thirty-seven minutes after it fired, at the exact moment the tape had come back to within 0.38 of the limit and honouring it was most expensive. The structure of the entry is what earns the grade rather than the decision alone: the fact that most undermines the kill - TGT closer to filling than at any point since 12:22 - is stated in its own paragraph and flagged as being stated first rather than after; the honest counter-argument that the test had outlived its own rationale is set out at its full strength and then refused on a stated ground; and the entry writes down IN ADVANCE what would make the kill wrong, so a later run could convict it on its own terms. It also gets the distinction that matters for tomorrow: the thesis did not break, both written invalidations were untouched at the kill, and the specification died of a drought at its own limit - which is why TGT stays a legitimate candidate and 159.36 stays dead. GRADED OUTCOME-BLIND AND THE OUTCOME IS RECORDED SEPARATELY BECAUSE IT CUTS BOTH WAYS AND CHANGES NOTHING HERE: the level printed on fourteen of the nineteen bars after this kill and would have filled outright, and the close then came in 1.09 below the limit so the withdrawal saved 2.18. Neither fact was available at 14:22 and neither adjusts this grade by anything.

entries.body: THE BOOK IS FLAT SO NO EXIT IS DUE, THERE IS NO LONGER A LIVE SPECIFICATION TO RE-VALIDATE - AND THE LEVEL KILLED AN HOUR AGO CAME BACK AND WOULD HAVE FILLED, WHICH IS REPORTED IN FULL BECAUSE IT IS EVIDENCE AGAINST A TEST THIS BOARD WROTE ITSELF.
