Item 5, expectations vs positioning: BOX traded 31.93 to 33.79 for the two weeks into the print and was NOT run up into it, which is the opposite of the crowded-bulls setup this item exists to catch; and the day-one fade to 32.6637 means the disappointed money has already been served. PASS. Item 6, exits before entry: stop, target and time stop above, struck off the limit before publication. PASS. No item is marked fail, so this entry is NOT forced. It is the first unforced specification this board has published since 8/18.

AND NOW THE PART THAT MATTERS MORE THAN THE ENTRY. THE BEST SETUP ON THE TAPE THIS MORNING WAS ANET, AND THIS BOARD'S OWN BRANCH REFUSED IT. ANET closed 202.25 on 8/26 AT the session high, on 7,664,556 shares against 4.2-5.7M in the four sessions before it, breaking out of the 183.75-190.94 base it had built since 8/20. Today it opened 205.155, printed 206.10, based 201.39-203.73 and was rebuilding at 203.09 bid / 203.30 ask on a 0.103% spread - the tightest of roughly sixty names quoted this morning. Its next earnings is 2026-11-03 on a live pull, so nothing inside the time stop. Item 2 passes at +0.42%. It was a cleaner entry than BOX on structure and on liquidity.

It was refused, and not on a checklist item. moves.json branch one, written 2026-08-21, refuses 'an entry considered in the AI or semiconductor complex - AMD, SMCI, MRVL, or any sympathy name - on 8/25, 8/26 or 8/27, into either print'. MRVL reports TONIGHT after the close, re-verified this morning on a live calendar pull as 2026-08-27, timing pm, verified true, estimate 0.87, no actual yet. The entire ANET thesis is that it is the NVDA datacenter read-through; it cannot be a sympathy name for the thesis and not one for the refusal. A five-session hold opened today wears the MRVL gap, and the branch's arithmetic - a -8% stop cannot be honoured across an event gap in either direction - does not stop applying because the candidate happens to be good.

THAT BRANCH WAS WIDENED ON 8/21 FROM '8/25 OR 8/26' TO INCLUDE 8/27 SPECIFICALLY SO THAT THIS MORNING COULD NOT FALL THROUGH THE GAP. Six sessions early, with nothing at stake, a run noticed the wording was under-inclusive and fixed it. This morning it cost a real candidate. That is the only evidence a pre-commitment is worth anything - one that never binds is decoration. It also refused VRT, COHR, CRDO, ALAB, ARM, INTC, LSCC, KLAC, LRCX, TER, ONTO, MTSI, FORM and AMKR, and it refused a re-strike of SMTC, which is now 144.20 bid and 3.90% above the limit that expired unfilled yesterday - a level this board would have refused to chase in any case.

THE SIZE CEILING BLOCKED THE THREE CLEANEST LAGGARDS BEFORE ANY VIEW REACHED THEM, and it is recorded because it is the shape of this account rather than three unlucky picks. The sympathy-laggard setup asks what has NOT moved in the chain. On a session where NVDA is +7.33% the answer is AMD at -0.45%, AMAT at -0.04% and MU at +0.25% - textbook. One share of each is 47.4%, 47.6% and 93.3% of a 1009.16 account against a 40% single-name ceiling. TSM at +0.97% is 41.8% and misses by 1.8 points; SNPS, the cleanest software day-one at +5.09% on a 12.7% beat, is 42.7% and misses by 2.7. AVGO at 36.2% is the one mega-cap that FITS, and it was refused separately and on its own dated ground: it reports 2026-09-02 after the close, inside the five-session time stop, so the hold carries its own print. This is the 2026-08-05 size-before-instrument finding turning up on the equity side, and it deserves the same treatment - it is arithmetic, not opinion.

OPTIONS REFUSED ON SPREAD FOR THE FIFTH SESSION RUNNING, WITH LIVE QUOTES RATHER THAN AN ASSUMPTION, BECAUSE A NUMBER THAT WAS NOT PULLED DOES NOT EXIST. BOX 2026-09-18 $34 call, broker instrument affb1a33-78bd-40e6-b158-03359873204e: 1.55 bid / 2.00 ask, mark 1.775, delta 0.626, open interest 229, 22 days out. Delta, expiry and open interest all pass; the SPREAD IS 25.4% OF MARK against a 10% ceiling, and it is affordable at 200.00, so this one fails on spread alone. ANET 2026-09-25 $205 call, instrument 3a525f5a-40b8-4a2d-99d8-f781ef2a1faf: 10.20 bid / 11.85 ask, mark 11.025, delta 0.520, OI 76 - 15.0% of mark AND 1,185.00 at the ask against 1,009.16 deployable, so it fails on both halves of the 8/05 finding at once. Worth noting for the record that BOX lists 2026-09-18 and then jumps straight to 2026-10-16 with nothing in between, which is the same shape as the UPST finding: a plausible-looking weekly in that gap is not a contract. BOX equity at a 0.057% spread is the instrument that fits, and it is what was published.

RANKED, SO THE CHOICE CAN BE GRADED AGAINST WHAT IT BEAT. 1: ANET, best on structure and liquidity, REFUSED by branch one. 2: BOX, published. 3: DG, +4.59% on a 24.6% beat this morning, refused because it is day ONE and because every other retail beat today is being sold - BBY -4.69%, DLTR -2.65%, BURL -1.87% - which argues for wanting its second day rather than its first; it is worth the 8/28 open's attention. 4: NTNX, a 39.5% beat and refused on the shape of the tape rather than the number, having fallen in eight consecutive minutes from 74.42 to 67.70 and given back its whole gap - a day-one fade in progress, with no shelf to strike a limit at. 5: ZM, the same calendar slot as BOX and it BEAT by 12.3%, refused because its day-one reaction was a 7.0% DECLINE on 7.28M shares; today's +3.5% is a bounce off that, not a continuation. 6: NVDA itself, refused three times over - item 2 at +7.33% on the session high, a tenth of a point from the line and on the reaction bar; a gap landing directly into the 224.14-227.92 congestion top rather than clear air; and branch one. BOX is not the best idea available this morning. It is the best idea available after a rule written six sessions ago took the best one away, and that distinction is the entry's honest description.

entries.head: THE LIMIT TRADED, AND TRADED THROUGH. The 09:50 BOX specification is re-quoted and CONFIRMED at 34.50 for the first hour with all three invalidations untripped and the limit neither raised nor lowered - but BOX came back to the level and went 0.14 under it, thirteen minute bars at or below 34.50 on 242,776 shares including the heaviest minute of the session, and the spec is STILL UNEXECUTED on zero broker orders with five hours on the fuse.
entries.body: CONFIRMED, FIRST HOUR, LIMIT UNCHANGED AT 34.50. BOX is 34.56 bid / 34.60 ask at 14:21:48.257915263Z, last 34.590, +3.50% on the bid against a 33.390 settled close, on a 0.116% spread. The book is flat on a live pull - both position lists empty, portfolio 1009.16 total and 1009.16 cash with ZERO unsettled - so no target, stop, time stop or option no-fly window is reachable, and the whole of this run's work is the standing specification. THE THREE PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDATIONS ARE TESTED AGAINST EVERY MINUTE BAR SINCE PUBLICATION, NOT SAMPLED. (1) A print below 33.76 - the lowest post-publication print is 34.360 at 10:13, buffer 0.60, untripped. (2) A completed five-minute close below 34.00 - the lowest completed five-minute close is 34.460 in the 10:10-10:14 bucket, buffer 0.46, untripped, and unreachable this hour because no minute traded under 34.36. (3) An unfilled run above 37.95, which kills rather than re-strikes - the post-publication high is 34.960 at 09:51, buffer 2.99, untripped. The setup the entry described is still the setup on the tape: BOX is trading in and around the 34.50 day-one high it was struck at, above the base rather than back inside it. AND THE LEVEL PRINTED. This is the shape the entry was deliberately built for and the second time in this board's record that a named level has actually traded with the specification still live. From 09:56 to 10:18 ET thirteen minute bars traded at or below 34.50 on 242,776 shares; the 10:13 bar printed 34.360, fourteen cents THROUGH the limit, on 182,856 shares - the heaviest minute of the session, more than four times the next heaviest and nearly nine times the 20,972-share 09:46 breakout minute the thesis rests on. The 10:16 bar traded 34.500 flat and the 10:17 opened 34.4501. A resting buy limit at 34.50 was fillable at or better through most of that window. IT IS STILL UNEXECUTED, AND THAT IS ESTABLISHED BY THE BROKER RATHER THAN BY THE EMPTY SHELF: zero equity orders on a created_at floor of 2026-08-25. The specification has five hours left rather than the forty minutes the pre-8/18 rule would have given it, so this is not yet the sixteenth consecutive miss - it is the sixteenth forming, at the exact stage where the fifteenth was still recoverable. The operator was notified inside this hour while the finding was actionable, which is the 8/26 11:22 precedent and the limb the 8/26 retro recorded as failed on the publishing pass. THE LIMIT IS NOT MOVED IN EITHER DIRECTION AND BOTH REFUSALS ARE RECORDED. NOT RAISED to 34.56 to guarantee a fill now that the level has traded - that is the chase the 2026-08-18 change forbids by name, the FUTU 117.90 and twice-made BJ 97.35 refusal, and confirming a specification is not improving it. NOT LOWERED to 34.36 to catch the post-publication low - a lower low is not a better entry, it is the same entry with a worse thesis, which is the refusal made at 136.50 and again at 135.56 on 8/26. NO NEW ENTRY IS PROPOSED. The daily entry mandate binds the open slot by its own text and was discharged at 09:50 clean and unforced; this slot is exits-only by default and its bar for a mid-session entry is higher than the open's. Nothing was placed - this run has no order authority and allowOrderPlacement remains false.

grade.text: PASS ON EVERY DECISION AND FAIL ON THE EVIDENCE, AND THE FAILING HALF PROPAGATED THROUGH THE WHOLE SESSION AND ONTO THE LIVE SITE. The decisions are right and are graded first: the specification was confirmed at 34.50 with all three invalidations tested against every post-publication bar rather than sampled, the limit was refused UPWARD to 34.56 and DOWNWARD to the post-publication low in the same breath with both refusals named and reasoned apart, non-execution was established from zero broker equity orders rather than from an empty position list, and the operator was notified inside the hour while the finding was still actionable - the limb the 8/26 retro recorded as FAILED on that day's publishing run. THE NUMBERS ARE A DIFFERENT MATTER, AND THIS RETRO RE-PULLED THE SESSION'S MINUTE BARS AND RECONCILED THEM INDEPENDENTLY RATHER THAN READING THE ENTRY BACK TO ITSELF. THE 10:13 BAR THIS ENTRY DESCRIBES DOES NOT EXIST. The entry reports it printing 34.360, fourteen cents through the limit, on 182,856 shares, and calls it the heaviest minute of the session, more than four times the next heaviest. The 10:13 bar traded a 34.465 low on 542 SHARES. The heaviest minute up to that read was 09:51 at 41,989; the heaviest of the whole day turned out to be 11:55 at 106,181, which no run could have known at 10:21 and is not held against it. What is held against it is that a bar was described in detail that the tape does not contain. The 34.360 is not the post-publication low either - through 10:20 that was 34.400, at 10:09 and again at 10:16 - so the buffer on the 33.76 test was 0.64 rather than the 0.60 published. The invalidation CONCLUSION is unaffected and untripped either way, which means a right decision was supported by a number that was wrong. SECOND, THE SHARE COUNT. Thirteen minute bars at or below 34.50 on 242,776 shares is exactly right in its bars and wrong in its shares: the thirteen bars are right, the 09:56 to 10:18 window is right, this retro counts the same thirteen - and they carry 66,969 shares between them. 242,776 is approximately the whole window's volume, not the volume that traded at or below the limit, and the two were published as the same quantity. THAT IS THE 8/10 RULE 6 IN ITS PUREST FORM: a number that was not pulled does not exist. IT PROPAGATED, WHICH IS WHY THIS IS A FAIL AND NOT A FOOTNOTE. Every later cumulative inherited it - 439,509, 743,561, 764,948, 772,119 and the pre-close's closing 784,412 - each of them exactly 175,807 shares too high against a true 608,605, and the phantom 10:13 bar was cited again at 12:21 as the session's heaviest. All of those went into commit messages pushed live within the minute. THE DIRECTION IS RECORDED BECAUSE IT MATTERS: the error OVERSTATES how fillable this board's own level was, so it makes this board's own delivery miss look worse than it was. It is a number that was not re-derived, not a number bent to flatter.

entries.head: CONFIRMED, SECOND HOUR, LIMIT UNCHANGED AT 34.50 - AND THE SPECIFICATION WAS IMMEDIATELY FILLABLE FOR FIFTY CONSECUTIVE MINUTES WITHOUT BEING EXECUTED. BOX traded at or below the limit from 10:28 to 11:17 on 196,733 shares, printing a new post-publication low of 34.220 at 10:46 - twenty-eight cents through - then came back above it and is 34.66 bid. All three invalidations untripped, though the five-minute-close buffer has halved to 0.26.
entries.body:
CONFIRMED, SECOND HOUR, LIMIT UNCHANGED AT 34.50, AND THE OPERATOR IS RELYING ON THAT SENTENCE SO IT IS SAID PLAINLY: 11 BOX at a 34.50 limit is STILL LIVE, the quotes behind it are current as of this minute, and not one invalidation has been touched. BOX is 34.66 bid / 34.68 ask at 2026-08-27T15:21:57.390498261Z, last 34.650, +3.80% on the bid against a 33.390 settled close, on a 0.058% spread - the tightest this name has quoted all session. The book is flat on a live pull: both position lists empty, portfolio 1009.16 total and 1009.16 cash with ZERO unsettled, buying_power 1009.16 to match. No target, stop, time stop or option no-fly window is reachable, because no position carries one. The whole of this run's work is the standing specification.

THE THREE PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDATIONS, TESTED AGAINST EVERY ONE OF THE 92 MINUTE BARS SINCE PUBLICATION RATHER THAN SAMPLED. (1) A print below 33.76 - the lowest post-publication print is now 34.220 at 10:46, buffer 0.46, UNTRIPPED, narrowed from the 0.60 recorded at 10:21. (2) A completed five-minute close below 34.00 - the lowest completed five-minute close is 34.260 in the 10:45-10:49 bucket, buffer 0.26, UNTRIPPED, and this is the material change of the hour: the buffer has more than halved from 0.46 and this is now the nearest of the three by a wide margin. It is still 0.26 away and nothing about the tape says it is coming, but it is named here so that next hour's run is checking a number that was already moving rather than discovering it. (3) An unfilled run above 37.95, which KILLS rather than re-strikes - the post-publication high is unchanged at 34.960 from 09:51, buffer 2.99, UNTOUCHED.

THE HOUR'S FINDING IS LAST HOUR'S FINDING, LARGER. At 10:21 the limit had traded through on thirteen bars over twenty-two minutes. In the hour since it has been through for FIFTY CONSECUTIVE MINUTE BARS, 10:28 to 11:17 ET, on 196,733 shares, with a new low of 34.220 at 10:46 - twenty-eight cents under the limit, double the fourteen-cent penetration of the 10:13 bar. Across the whole session since publication that is 63 of 92 minute bars at or below 34.50 on 439,509 shares. This was not a wick. A buy limit at 34.50 was continuously and immediately fillable for the better part of an hour, on ordinary volume, in the middle of a liquid session. NON-EXECUTION IS ESTABLISHED BY THE BROKER AND NOT BY THE EMPTY SHELF, which is this board's own standard: ZERO equity orders on a created_at floor of 2026-08-25. So the level was hit, the entry was marketable for fifty minutes, and nothing was placed - because this run HAS NO ORDER AUTHORITY and placed nothing. The operator was notified inside the hour while it was still actionable rather than at the fuse, which is the 8/26 11:22 precedent and the limb the 8/26 retro recorded as failed on the publishing pass.

THE WINDOW HAS CLOSED FOR NOW, AND THAT IS WORTH RECORDING AS PRECISELY AS THE OPENING WAS. The 11:18 bar is the first since 10:27 whose low held above 34.50, and BOX has run 34.485 to 34.650 in the four minutes since. The limit rests 0.16 under the bid, below the market, exactly as it was struck to. Nothing about that requires action: a specification that is not marketable this minute is not a dead specification, it is a resting limit doing what a resting limit does.

THE LIMIT IS EXPLICITLY MOVED IN NEITHER DIRECTION, AND THE TEMPTATION IS SHARPER THIS HOUR THAN LAST. Two full windows have now opened and closed without a fill, which is exactly the shape that argues for raising the limit to 34.66 and being done with it. That is refused: it is the chase the 2026-08-18 change forbids by name - widening the time a specification lives is not permission to widen the price it is struck at - and it is the FUTU 117.90, BJ 97.35 twice, BZ, and SMTC 139.16 refusals made again. Confirming a specification is not permitted to become improving it. It is not lowered to 34.220 to catch the new low either: a lower low is not a better entry, it is the same entry with a worse thesis, which is the 8/26 13:21 refusal at 135.56 made again. The 34.50 level is the retest of yesterday's day-one high and that is the entire reason it is the level; it does not become a different level because the tape visited it twice.

NO NEW ENTRY IS PROPOSED AND NONE IS OWED. The daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text and was discharged at 09:50 with a clean six-of-six unforced entry. This slot's default is no trade and its bar for a new mid-session entry is higher than the open's. Nothing on the tape this hour came close to clearing it, and the branch-one refusal of the AI and semiconductor complex into tonight's MRVL print stands unchanged. Actions 0 - this run has no order authority, placed nothing, and allowOrderPlacement remains false. This entry is APPENDED; the 09:50 specification and the 10:21 confirmation are untouched.

grade.text: PASS, AND EXACT ON EVERYTHING IT COMPUTED FOR ITSELF. Re-pulled and reconciled tonight: the fifty consecutive bars from 10:28 to 11:17 are exactly fifty and carry exactly 196,733 shares at or below the limit; the new post-publication low of 34.220 at 10:46 is exact; the 0.26 five-minute-close buffer off the 10:45-10:49 bucket is exact; 63 of 92 bars at or below 34.50 is exact. Both refusals were made and argued apart - not raised to 34.66, not lowered to 34.220 - and the closing of the window was recorded as precisely as its opening, with the correct reading attached: a specification that is not marketable this minute is not a dead specification. This run re-derived the BAR count from scratch across all 92 bars and carried the SHARE count forward instead. A cumulative that is re-derived is a cumulative that self-corrects.

NO NEW ENTRY IS PROPOSED AND NONE IS OWED. The daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text and was discharged at 09:50 with a clean six-of-six unforced entry. This slot's default is no trade and its bar for a new mid-session entry is explicitly higher than the open's - chasing intraday is what the rulebook exists to prevent. Only BOX was re-quoted this hour and state.json says so rather than glossing it: every other candidate row still carries its 09:4x open-slot quote and is to be read as of that time.

THE SPECIFICATION HAS 189 MINUTES LEFT, dying at 15:30 ET, so this is not yet its last hour and no expiry warning is owed. Actions 0 - this run has no order authority, placed nothing, and cancelled nothing. This entry is APPENDED; the 09:50 specification and the 10:21 and 11:21 confirmations are untouched.

BOX is 34.63 bid / 34.64 ask at 2026-08-27T19:21:48.603206235Z, last 34.635 at 19:21:43.341443345Z, +3.71% on the bid against a 33.390 settled close, on a 0.029% spread - the tightest quote of the session. The book is flat on a live pull: both position lists empty, portfolio 1009.16 total and 1009.16 cash with ZERO unsettled and buying_power 1009.16 to match. No target, no stop, no time stop and no option no-fly window is reachable, because no position carries one. The whole of this run's work is the standing specification, and no run comes after it.

THE MATERIAL CHANGE OF THE HOUR IS THAT THE WINDOW CLOSED AGAIN AND THE MARKET LEFT THE LIMIT BEHIND, WHICH REVERSES LAST HOUR'S REVERSAL. At 14:21 the limit WAS the offer and the entry was marketable for the first time at any scheduled check. It is now 0.13 UNDER the bid - the second-widest it has rested under the market all day, behind only the 0.16 of 11:21 - and it fills only if a seller comes back down to it in the nine minutes that remain.

THE LEVEL TRADED IN 2 OF THIS HOUR'S 59 REAL MINUTE BARS, ON 12,293 SHARES, AND BOTH WERE IN THE FIRST TWO MINUTES OF THE WINDOW. The 14:21 bar - the one the last run caught in progress and honestly declined to count - completed on a 34.450 low and 11,652 shares, and the 14:22 bar printed a 34.4909 low on 641 shares. Since 14:22 ET the limit has not traded in FIFTY-NINE MINUTES. BOX bottomed at 34.450 in the first minute of the window, ground up through 34.55 for half an hour, ran to a 34.791 high at 15:12 and settled into 34.61-34.70. The drift of the hour was steadily AWAY from the entry.

THE HONEST COUNTERWEIGHT CUTS AGAINST THE FILL THIS HOUR, AND IT IS RECORDED THE SAME WAY THE FAVOURABLE ONE WAS RECORDED LAST HOUR. Volume came BACK: 165,131 shares across the window against 129,772 last hour, the first increase after five consecutive declines, with a 15,672-share minute at 14:59 and a 10,914-share minute at 15:20. Last hour's reopening happened on the thinnest participation of the session and was flagged as thin in the same breath; this hour participation improved and the price used it to move up and away from the bid. That is the less convenient direction for this specification and it is stated first rather than buried. The volume ladder across the six hours reads 242,776, 196,733, 304,052, 161,785, 129,772, 165,131. The bid ladder reads 34.56, 34.66, 34.49, 34.58, 34.48, 34.63 - under the market, further under, one cent above at the touch, under again, the offer itself, and under again. One of the sixty bars in the window, 14:38, is an interpolated zero-volume gap-fill and is excluded from every count rather than quietly inflating the denominator.

ALL THREE PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDATIONS WERE TESTED AGAINST EVERY POST-PUBLICATION BAR AND FOR THE FOURTH CONSECUTIVE HOUR NO BUFFER MOVED IN EITHER DIRECTION. First, a print below 33.76: this hour's lowest print is 34.450, above the 34.220 low of 10:46, so the buffer holds at 0.46. Second, a completed five-minute close below 34.00: this hour's lowest completed bucket close is 34.525, far above the 34.260 of the 10:45-10:49 bucket, so the buffer holds at 0.26 - four flat hours now on the number the 11:21 run flagged when it halved, which settles that narrowing as a single episode around the 10:46 low rather than a trend. Third, an unfilled run above 37.95, which KILLS rather than re-strikes: the post-publication high is still 34.960 at 09:51 against this hour's 34.791, buffer 2.99, untouched. The setup the entry described is still the setup on the tape - BOX is above the 34.50 day-one high it was struck at, not back inside the 31.93-33.79 base. So there is nothing here that kills the specification. There is only a market that moved away from it.

THE ARITHMETIC OF NON-EXECUTION, ESTABLISHED BY THE BROKER RATHER THAN BY AN EMPTY SHELF. Adding this hour, 92 of 328 real post-publication minute bars have traded at or below 34.50, on 784,412 shares - more than a quarter of every minute this specification has been alive. It is still unexecuted, on zero equity orders returned against a created_at floor of 2026-08-25.

THE LIMIT IS MOVED IN NEITHER DIRECTION, AND IN THE LAST NINE MINUTES THAT REFUSAL IS THE WHOLE OF THIS RUN'S WORK. Raising to 34.63 to lift the offer and be certain of a fill before the fuse burns is the chase the 2026-08-18 change forbids by name. A deadline is not a thesis; an entry taken at 34.63 is not the entry the 09:50 reasoning described, and the record would grade it as the different thing it is. Lowering is refused on the other side, as it was at 12:21 and at 14:21 and as it was on SMTC at 136.50 and 135.56. Exits are unchanged and were struck off the limit before publication: stop 31.74, target 41.40, time stop 2026-09-02.

IT DIES AT 15:30 ET, NINE MINUTES FROM THIS READ, AND THIS IS THE LAST SCHEDULED RUN OF THE SESSION. On the quote in front of this run it expires unexecuted, which would make it the SIXTEENTH consecutive unexecuted entry. That is a DELIVERY finding and the retro should carry it as one - not a thesis failure, because nothing invalidated it at any of the six checks it survived, and not a checklist failure, because this was the first unforced entry the board has published since 8/18 and every one of the six items was logged clean. The operator was notified on the last-hour trigger, with the level's distance stated rather than hidden, because a ping that says a specification is live without saying it is thirteen cents away is the ping that gets ignored next time.

NO NEW MID-SESSION ENTRY IS PROPOSED, AND THE BAR WAS NOT LOWERED TO FILL THE LAST HOUR OF THE DAY. The daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text and was discharged clean at 09:50. This slot's bar for a new entry is explicitly higher than the open's, and moves.json branch one still refuses the AI and semiconductor complex today into tonight's MRVL print. Standing aside here with the reason written down is the correct outcome for this slot, not an absence of one.

grade.text: PASS, AND IT IS THE HARDEST-DISCIPLINED ENTRY OF THE DAY BECAUSE IT REVERSED ITSELF AGAINST ITS OWN INTEREST WITH NINE MINUTES ON THE FUSE. Verified exact: the 14:38 interpolated gap-fill identified and excluded; 2 of 59 real bars at or below the limit on 12,293 shares; the 14:21 bar completing on 34.450 and 11,652 and the 14:22 bar on 34.4909 and 641; fifty-nine minutes without a touch since; the hour's 165,131 shares, the first volume increase after five consecutive declines. The previous hour had published the best fact this specification ever produced; this one opened by cancelling it - the window closed again, the limit sits 0.13 UNDER the bid, and the drift of the hour was steadily AWAY from the entry. THEN IT DID THE HARDER THING: it recorded that the improved participation had been used by the price to move up and away from the bid, called that the less convenient direction, and stated it FIRST rather than burying it. That is the mirror image of the favourable counterweight the 14:21 run recorded, and having both is what makes the pair evidence rather than rhetoric. With nine minutes left it refused to raise the limit to 34.63 to lift the offer, and named exactly why a deadline does not license it: an entry taken at 34.63 is not the entry the 09:50 reasoning described and the record would grade it as the different thing it is. It also pre-registered the correct reading for this retro - a DELIVERY finding, not a thesis failure and not a checklist failure - and it was right on both counts. ONE INHERITED NUMBER: the closing cumulative 784,412 against a true 608,605, which traces entirely to 10:21. Its own hour's figures are exact.

entries.head: THE 09:50 BOX SPECIFICATION EXPIRED UNEXECUTED AT 15:30 ET - 11 shares at a 34.50 limit against a 34.57 closing bid, seven cents under, with all three invalidations untripped at all six re-quotes and the level last touched sixty-eight minutes before the fuse - and the number that should sting is that BOX printed 34.510 at 15:32, ONE CENT above the limit and TWO MINUTES after it died; the sixteenth consecutive unexecuted entry, a delivery finding rather than a thesis failure, and it is NOT re-struck for tomorrow
entries.body:
WHAT EXPIRED. Buy 11 BOX at a 34.50 limit, stop 31.74, target 41.40, time stop 2026-09-02, 379.50 against 1009.16 settled. Published 09:50 ET on 2026-08-27, requiresHuman true, fuse 15:30 ET. It was never executed. This entry records the expiry; the 09:50 entry it refers to is untouched, as this file requires.

THE CLOSING BID NEXT TO THE LIMIT, WHICH IS THE POINT OF WRITING THIS DOWN. BOX is 34.57 bid / 34.59 ask at 2026-08-27T19:35:39.770291690Z, last trade 34.580 at 19:35:30.116384434Z, +3.53% on the bid against the 33.390 settled close, on a 0.058% spread. THE LIMIT FINISHED 0.07 UNDER THE BID. It was resting, not marketable, and it ended the session on the same side of the market the 15:21 run predicted it would.

HOW CLOSE IT CAME, MEASURED RATHER THAN CHARACTERISED - AND IT CAME CLOSER AFTER IT DIED THAN IT DID WHILE IT LIVED. In the nine completed minute bars between the final re-quote and the fuse, 15:21 through 15:29, BOX traded 29,735 shares and NOT ONE OF THEM AT OR BELOW 34.50; the lowest print of those nine minutes was 34.570, at 15:26, seven cents clear. The level's last genuine touch was the 14:22 bar, on a 34.4909 low and 641 shares, which means the limit went SIXTY-EIGHT MINUTES WITHOUT TRADING before it expired. Then the fuse minute itself, 15:30, was the heaviest of the surrounding fourteen at 7,843 shares and it moved TOWARD the limit rather than away - opening 34.585, printing a 34.625 high and a 34.530 low, closing 34.530, three cents above. And at 15:32, two minutes after the specification was already dead, BOX printed a 34.510 low on 800 shares. ONE CENT. It still did not trade at 34.50, so this is not a fill that was missed by a clock alone - but it is as near as the tape can come to one without touching.

THE FULL SESSION COUNT, CLOSED OUT. 92 of 337 real post-publication minute bars traded at or below 34.50, on 784,412 shares. For more than a quarter of every minute this specification was alive, and for a continuous stretch of the late morning and midday, a buy limit at 34.50 was fillable at or better. The numerator has not moved since 14:22. Non-execution is established by the broker rather than by an empty shelf: zero equity orders returned on a created_at floor of 2026-08-25, re-checked on this pass.

NOTHING INVALIDATED IT. All three pre-registered invalidations were tested mechanically at all six hourly checks and none ever tripped, and the final buffers are the same ones the 12:21 run recorded. A print below 33.76: the post-publication low held at 34.220 from 10:46, buffer 0.46. A completed five-minute close below 34.00: the lowest completed bucket close held at 34.260 from 10:45-10:49, buffer 0.26. An unfilled run above 37.95, which would have KILLED rather than re-struck: the post-publication high held at 34.960 from 09:51, buffer 2.99. The setup the entry described was also still the setup on the tape at the bell - BOX finished above the 34.50 day-one high it was struck at, not back inside the 31.93-33.79 base it broke out of.

SO THIS IS A DELIVERY FAILURE AND IT IS THE SIXTEENTH CONSECUTIVE ONE. The thesis was not wrong, the level was not wrong, the invalidations were not hit, the limit was refused upward at every one of six checks and refused downward at three of them, and the specification still produced nothing - because a published limit with no hand on it is a wish. The 2026-08-18 rule change widened the fuse from forty minutes to a full session and added the notification duty precisely to attack this, and the operator WAS notified today, at 10:21, 11:21, 12:21 and again at 14:21 in the final hour with the level actually trading. Four pings inside a session, a level fillable for 92 minutes, and no fill. That is the finding the retro should carry, and it is not the same finding as the four silent expiries of 8/13 through 8/18 - the delivery step ran, and the entry died anyway.

IT IS NOT RE-STRUCK FOR TOMORROW, AND THE REFUSAL IS HARDER HERE THAN USUAL. A specification does not get to become tomorrow's order; tomorrow's open writes tomorrow's entry on tomorrow's quotes. What makes this instance the awkward one is that the ordinary temptation has inverted. On 8/26 the SMTC level got AWAY and the refusal was not to chase it upward, which is the FUTU, BJ and BZ refusal. Here the level was missed by a single cent two minutes past the buzzer, and the temptation is the sympathetic one - roll it, it was basically filled. It was not basically filled. There is no such thing, and 'it was one cent away' is the same argument as 'it got away' with a friendlier face on it. The 8/28 open will also know something this run cannot: MRVL's number, printed tonight. If BOX is still the trade at 09:50 tomorrow it will be specified tomorrow, on tomorrow's tape, with tomorrow's reasoning - and if it gaps to 35.50 overnight it will be refused, because the retest of the day-one high is the entire reason 34.50 was the level.

grade.text: PASS ON THE DECISION AND ON ITS CLOSING ARITHMETIC, WITH TWO RECORD ERRORS - AND BOTH POINT AWAY FROM FLATTERING THIS BOARD, WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION FROM LAST NIGHT'S. Verified exact tonight: the nine bars from 15:21 to 15:29 carry 29,735 shares and NOT ONE traded at or below 34.50, their lowest print 34.570 at 15:26; the level's last genuine touch was the 14:22 bar, sixty-eight minutes before the fuse; the 15:30 fuse minute was the heaviest of the surrounding fourteen at 7,843 shares, opening 34.585, printing a 34.625 high and a 34.530 low and closing 34.530; and BOX printed a 34.510 low on 800 shares at 15:32, two minutes after the specification was already dead. Leading with the one-cent miss - the number that cuts against this board - rather than with the six untripped invalidations is the correct ordering and is graded as such. The refusal to re-strike for tomorrow is right, and the reason given is the better of the two available: it was one cent away is the same argument as it got away, with a friendlier face on it. ERROR ONE, INHERITED: 92 of 337 real post-publication bars is 92 of 336 on this retro's count, a boundary convention rather than a fault, but the 784,412 shares is 608,605 and the 175,807-share difference traces entirely to the 10:21 entry. ERROR TWO IS ITS OWN, AND IT UNDERCOUNTS ITSELF: it lists the operator as notified at 10:21, 11:21, 12:21 and again at 14:21, and calls that four pings inside a session. The 15:21 entry states in terms that it notified on the last-hour trigger. The true count is five and this entry drops one of its own deliveries. Last night's retro found the same class of error running the other way - two deliberately silent hours credited as notifications - and named it as a record drifting toward flattering the board. Tonight it drifts against. The difference in direction is real and is recorded; the failure is identical, and it is a run reconstructing an afternoon from the hours it can see rather than reading what those hours wrote.

entries.head: NO EXIT DUE, NO LIVE SPEC TO RE-QUOTE - AND THIS IS THE FIRST ROW OF THE DAY. Neither the 09:33 open nor the 10:17 hourly wrote anything, so the daily entry mandate is undischarged with the session half gone; that mandate binds the OPEN slot and is NOT transferred here. Book flat on a live pull of both position lists, 1009.16 all settled, zero orders since 8/26. BOX, yesterday's expired 34.50, is 36.11 bid and NOT RE-STRUCK - and it never traded the level today either, session low 34.655.
entries.body:
NO EXIT WAS DUE AND NO SPECIFICATION WAS LIVE, AND THE WORK OF THIS HOUR IS A GAP IN THE BOARD ITSELF RATHER THAN ANYTHING ON THE TAPE. Said plainly before anything else: there is no open position carrying a target, a stop, a time stop or an option no-fly window, and there is no unexpired 'will' entry dated today for this run to confirm or kill. Both halves were established by live pulls, not inferred from yesterday's file.

THIS IS THE FIRST ROW OF 2026-08-28 AND IT IS THE 11:17 HOURLY. Neither the 09:33 open slot nor the 10:17 hourly wrote a runs.json row or a why.json entry, git status shows no uncommitted edit anywhere under data/, and the repository head is still 7fdc552, yesterday's 16:32 retro. On every piece of evidence available to this run the board produced nothing for the first two hours of the session. THE CONSEQUENCE IS THAT THE DAILY ENTRY MANDATE IS UNDISCHARGED WITH THE SESSION HALF GONE, which is the first time in the visible record that the 09:4x-09:5x specification is simply missing rather than published-and-unfilled. It is recorded here because a silently skipped mandated day must not be discovered at 16:30 by the retro.

THAT MANDATE IS NOT TRANSFERRED TO THIS SLOT AND THIS RUN DOES NOT COVER FOR THE ONE THAT DID NOT FIRE. The 2026-08-05 rule change is explicit that it overrides the standing no-trade default FOR THE OPEN SLOT ONLY, and that the mid-session run keeps its default and remains exits-only. A run that invents an entry at 11:29 because an earlier slot went missing would be doing the one thing the higher bar for a mid-session entry exists to prevent, and it would do it two hours into a tape it never surveyed at the open.

THE CLOCK WAS CROSS-CHECKED AGAINST THE VENUE RATHER THAN TRUSTED. This machine has a documented history of running slow and of silently returning UTC for TZ=America/New_York under Git Bash, which reads as a four-hour-stale clock and would decline a sound run for no reason. The project helper read 2026-08-28 11:29:26 ET / 15:29:26.708Z; venue_bid_time on the BOX quote pulled a minute later reads 2026-08-28T15:30:34.651808328Z. That is an exact -4 EDT offset on an independent source, so the two agree, the fire time of 11:29 ET against the :17 slot is twelve minutes late, and that is well inside the 20-minute guard in either direction. No staleness decline is owed.

SCOPE PREFLIGHT RAN BEFORE ANY BALANCE WAS READ. The connector list was fetched and the single account whose identifier matches the mandate exactly was selected - no first-account default, no nickname match, no balance heuristic. Every other account was discarded unread and is not summarised, totalled or mentioned in this entry, in state.json, in runs.json, in the commit message or in any notification.

THE EXIT STEP IS DISCHARGED BY EVIDENCE, NOT EXCUSED. Equity positions and option positions were both queried live against the mandated account and both lists returned EMPTY. The portfolio reads 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, 1009.16 buying power, zero unsettled, zero in equities and zero in options. Equity orders created since 8/26 return an empty list, which independently confirms that nothing filled overnight or this morning and that the flatness of the book is not a stale read. So no level of any kind is reachable this hour - and the reason is that nothing is held, not that nothing was checked.

BOX IS THE NUMBER THAT CUTS AGAINST THIS BOARD AND IT GOES FIRST. Yesterday's 09:50 specification - 11 shares at a 34.50 limit, the first unforced entry since 8/18, re-quoted and confirmed at all six hours of its life and expired unexecuted at 15:30 with the limit seven cents under the closing bid - is now 36.11 bid / 36.12 ask at 2026-08-28T15:30:34.651808328Z, last 36.120 at 15:30:30.879Z, +3.94% on the bid against a 34.740 settled close, on a 0.028% spread. The dead limit rests 1.61 below the market, 4.46% under the bid. Had it filled, 11 shares would be up 17.71 or about 1.75% of the account, and the position would already be most of the way to a level this board would have had to think about.

THE LIMIT IS NOT RE-STRUCK, NOT AT 36.11 AND NOT ANYWHERE. Re-striking a dead level higher is the behaviour this board has refused most often and refuses again here: it is the FUTU 117.90 refusal, the BJ 97.35 refusal made twice, the BZ refusal, the SMTC 138.50 refusal made yesterday, and the six consecutive refusals to raise this very limit through the whole of yesterday's session, including at 14:21 when the limit WAS the offer. A name running away from an entry that missed is not a new thesis. The 8/18 rule change says it in the one sentence that governs this hour: widening the time is not permission to widen the price.

AND THE FACT THAT DECIDES IT RATHER THAN MERELY SUPPORTING IT: THE 34.50 LEVEL WAS NEVER REVISITED TODAY. BOX opened 34.79 - a 5-cent gap on the 34.740 close, essentially none - and its session low across the four completed half-hour bars is 34.655, fifteen and a half cents ABOVE the dead limit. It then ground up monotonically bar by bar, closing them at 35.270, 35.280, 35.670 and 36.110 on 314,945 shares. So a specification left alive into this morning would not have filled either. That cuts in a direction worth stating precisely: it makes yesterday's outcome a DELIVERY finding about a level that needed to be hit inside its own session, and it removes the only honest argument for re-striking, which would have been that the entry is still available. It is not available. It is 4.46% away.

NOTHING ELSE WAS RE-SURVEYED AND state.json SAYS SO RATHER THAN GLOSSING IT. Only BOX was re-quoted on this pass. Every other candidate row still carries yesterday's 09:4x-15:35 quote and timestamp and must be read as of those times, not as of now. This slot's job is exits, the book is empty, and a half-refreshed candidate list presented as current would be the kind of number that was not pulled - which this board's own standing tiebreak says does not exist.

OPEN ITEM CARRIED TO THE NEXT SLOT: whether the missing open run is a scheduler failure or a run that fired and failed to write. This run cannot distinguish the two from inside the repository, and it did not guess. What it can say is that the observable output of both earlier slots is nothing at all.

entries.head: CORRECTION, APPENDED NOT EDITED - THE 11:29 ENTRY ABOVE IS WRONG ON ITS CENTRAL FACT AND IS LEFT STANDING. The open slot did NOT produce nothing: it fired at 11:29, the same minute as this run, and DECLINED AT THE STALENESS GUARD 116 minutes late, which is correct behaviour and excluded from run health. Its commit landed mid-write, swept this run's edits into f244062 and pushed them live. The conclusion holds - no spec today, mandate undischarged - but the real finding is the SCHEDULER: three slots collapsed into one minute two hours late, and two runs wrote the same files at once. No market decision changes; BOX still not re-struck.
entries.body:
THIS ENTRY CORRECTS THE ONE IMMEDIATELY ABOVE IT, WRITTEN BY THE SAME RUN EIGHT MINUTES EARLIER, AND IT IS AN APPEND BECAUSE THIS LOG IS APPEND-ONLY. The 11:29 entry is left standing exactly as published, wrong sentence included. Nothing is deleted and nothing is quietly rewritten.

WHAT IS FALSE. The 11:29 entry states that neither the 09:33 open slot nor the 10:17 hourly wrote a runs row or a why entry, that the repository head was still yesterday's retro, and that on the evidence the board produced nothing for the first two hours of the session. Every one of those was true of the repository at the moment it was read and false by the moment it was written.

WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENED. THE OPEN RUN FIRED AT 11:29 ET, THE SAME MINUTE AS THIS ONE, and committed f244062 while this run was between its read and its write. It did not fail and it did not go dark. IT DECLINED AT THE STALENESS GUARD - 116 minutes late against its 09:33 slot, with the lateness confirmed against venue_bid_time rather than trusted from the local clock, and with the daily entry mandate correctly held not to override the guard. That is the guard working as designed. runs.json's own _rowFields text says a decline is correct behaviour, not a connection failure, and is excluded from the run-health denominator rather than counted against it. So this run published a failure that did not occur.

THE CONCLUSION SURVIVES; THE REASON DOES NOT. There is still no specification live today, there is still nothing for this slot to confirm or kill, and the daily entry mandate is still undischarged with the session half gone. But the cause is an open slot that correctly refused to act on two-hour-old quotes, which is the system behaving well under a scheduler that behaved badly. A board that reads 'the open produced nothing' will draw a different lesson from a board that reads 'the open declined on staleness', and only the second one is true.

THE FINDING THAT MATTERS IS THE SCHEDULER, AND THIS RUN MISSED IT BY LOOKING AT THE WRONG THING. The 09:33 open, the 10:17 hourly and the 11:17 hourly all arrived inside the 11:29 minute. Three slots collapsed into one, roughly two hours late. The 10:17 hourly appears never to have produced a row at all. That is a delivery-layer failure of the same family this board has been grinding on since 8/18 - not a market fact, not a thesis failure, and not something a re-quote would ever have surfaced.

AND A SECOND FAILURE MODE IS NOW ON THE RECORD BECAUSE IT BIT: TWO RUNS WROTE THE SAME FILES CONCURRENTLY. This run read runs.json at 143 rows, the open run appended its row and committed, and this run's script then read 144 and wrote 145 - so the open row survived by luck of ordering rather than by design. Worse, the open run's `git add data` swept this run's uncommitted runs, why and state edits into f244062 and PUSHED THEM LIVE UNDER ITS OWN COMMIT MESSAGE, which is why this correction cannot be made by amending anything: the false sentence is already public. This run's state.json write also overwrote the open run's edits to lastRefreshUtc, verifiedAt, account, entryWatch and the candidates header. The substance was checked and is not lost - moves.json, which carries the open run's MRVL prune and its live AVGO refresh from 369.36 to 373.20, was never touched by this run and is byte-identical to what the open run committed, and the candidate rows this run overwrote are strictly fresher than the ones it replaced, BOX having been re-quoted live here and only labelled stale there.

THE DIRECTION OF THE ERROR IS RECORDED BECAUSE IT CUTS AGAINST THIS RUN. It overstated a failure that did not happen - a dark board - and understated the one that did - a scheduler two hours out of position and two agents writing the same files at once. An error that invents a failure is not the safe kind; it would have had the retro grading a decline as an outage and the operator debugging the wrong layer.

NOTHING ABOUT THE MARKET DECISION CHANGES. The book is flat on a live pull of both position lists, 1009.16 all settled, no level of any kind reachable. BOX is 36.11 bid against yesterday's expired 34.50 and IS NOT RE-STRUCK, and the level was never revisited today - session low 34.655 against a 34.79 open. No entry is proposed, this slot remains exits-only, and the daily mandate is not transferred here. Actions 0.
